jobs.description:
Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them.
 Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past.
 We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here .
 
 About the Role 
 
 As a Project Manager at Sona, you'll own a portfolio of enterprise implementations end to end, working alongside a Solutions Architect on each project. Assignments are based on capacity and fit rather than a fixed team, so you'll work across sectors, hospitality, retail and social care.
 
 You'll run implementations of Sona's products (HR, Scheduling, Payroll, LMS & ATS) end to end, ensuring delivery meets our scope commitments, budgets and timelines, all while providing an exceptional experience for our customers. You'll partner closely with senior stakeholders from our customers and internally across our Commercial, Product and Customer teams. We're a growing business, so you'll also need to thrive in a fast-evolving environment and be a strong advocate for clarity and communication.
 
 Responsibilities 
 
 Lead and deliver projects on time, within scope and budget, maintaining the highest quality standards.

 Manage project risks, dependencies and scope, communicating mitigations and changes clearly to all stakeholders.

 Act as the primary customer advocate, building strong relationships and managing expectations throughout delivery.

 Coordinate internal teams, vendors and customers to ensure successful outcomes and efficient resource deployment.

 Produce clear, consistent documentation and status reports, escalating risks where required.

 Support our Land and Expand approach by driving strong customer partnerships and early value realisation.

 Continuously improve project processes and tools to enhance delivery speed, quality and customer satisfaction.

 
 Requirements 
 
 Proven success delivering enterprise software implementation projects on time, within budget and scope.

 Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, including working with C-level executives.

 Strong leadership and collaboration skills, able to influence without direct authority.

 Strategic thinker with strong risk management, planning and prioritisation capabilities.

 Calm, organised and results-driven under pressure, with excellent time management.

 Confident in presenting, reporting and managing multiple complex projects simultaneously.

 Comfortable using AI in your own workflow, notes, actions, tracking, and able to explain where you'd trust it and where you wouldn't.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Vertical Search
jobs.description:
The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

Vertical search is where we combine public sources with premium vertical data and shape the result into a product for a specific use case. This role owns that layer end to end. You decide which industries and use cases we productize. With the data team, you find and evaluate the public and premium data providers behind each one. You shape the product surface that sits on top.

You will sit with customers in these industries, learn how they actually work, and turn their needs and pain points into clear specs. You will build with engineering, ship it, and make sure go-to-market knows how to sell it. You own the outcome, not just the handoff: from the first market call through to adoption and revenue.

The hard part is choosing. There are more verticals worth building than we can build, and the difference between a good year and a wasted one is knowing which ones to invest in and which to walk away from, even when a large customer is asking for another.

The role

Tavily, part of Nebius, is the web access layer for AI agents. Over two million developers use us, and our customers include Fortune 500 companies running agents in production.

We build and run our own index. That means we own the hard problems directly: crawl coverage at scale, freshness, cost per query, and the quality of what comes back. This role owns that infrastructure as a product.

When an agent asks a question, the answer has to be relevant, fresh, fast, and affordable. Those four things pull against each other, and someone has to decide which one gives. That is you. You will set what good means for each use case we serve and the bar a change has to clear before it ships, working closely with our evaluation team, who own how we measure it. You will also shape where our index goes next: what it needs to cover, how fresh it needs to be, and what it has to be good at.

The most open part of the job is what comes next. Search is being rebuilt for a consumer that is not a person. Agents do not want one result page, they want to break a problem apart, run many retrievals, and decide what to do next. That changes what search infrastructure should look like, and part of your job is to have a view on where ours should go.

The hard part is deciding what good enough means. Perfect coverage, perfect freshness, and low cost cannot all be true at once, and the person in this seat is the one who has to make that call for each use case and defend it.

 Real-time, agentic AI has only just become good enough to hold a convincing live scenario, and to make sense of what happens inside one. The window to define this category is open now, and we intend to own it.
 
 The problem you're solving
 Today, the most a company can do to check whether someone has genuinely learned something is watch them complete a module or pass a quiz. The behaviors that matter in real roles, in real moments, are rarely tested reliably, and what comes back to the business is a thin, lagging signal.
 We have the underlying technology to change that. What we need is a product manager who can turn it into something an enterprise will use to prepare its people, and that an end user actually wants to engage with, across two connected domains:
 Surveys - capturing structured, trustworthy signal at scale: how people feel, how they're performing, and where the gaps are.

 Guidance - giving people direction in the moment they need it, live and in context, rather than as a debrief after the fact.

 Both sit inside the same bet: give organizations proof of readiness, not just proof of attendance.
 
 What you'll be doing
 Owning the multi-quarter strategy for Surveys and Guidance, setting the direction, identifying the right problems to solve, and making the trade-offs needed to deliver against them.

 Defining and evolving the success metrics for both domains, and connecting product outcomes directly to commercial results: retention, expansion, and revenue impact.

 Getting close to the customers who matter most: understanding how they think, where current tools leave them exposed, and translating that into a product direction others can act on.

 Driving a shared understanding of where these product areas are going and why. Engineering, design, R&D, and commercial counterparts should all be able to articulate the strategy and the reasoning behind it.

 Producing written narratives, strategy docs, and PRDs, that move decisions forward and give your team the context to build the right thing without a follow-up conversation.

 Balancing short-term delivery with long-term product health: scoping to reflect execution risk, hitting milestones predictably, and iterating based on evidence rather than opinion.

 Contributing to improvements in product practice across the team, and actively participating in PM hiring.
 

 Who you are
 You've owned a critical product domain before, one where the stakes were real and the strategy was yours to set, not just execute. You're comfortable operating with autonomy on the what, not just the how, and you have a track record of connecting product decisions to commercial outcomes.
 You understand that zero-to-one products in complex domains require you to hold two things at once: the discipline to deliver predictably in the short term, and the judgment to make the right long-term bets while the evidence is still forming. You don't wait for a clean brief. You identify the right problems, form a view, and bring others along.
 You're a strong written communicator. Engineering and design partners, commercial leads, and senior leadership should all come away from your docs and updates with a clear understanding of where the domain is going and why, without needing to ask.
 You care about the quality of the experience. Real-time, agentic products are unforgiving, and you hold a high bar for what "good" feels like, for the user in the moment and for the customer looking at outcomes.

 Significant experience in product management, with direct experience owning a critical product domain: se

 About us 
 Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance .

jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.description:
🚀 Why Midnite? 
 Midnite is a next-generation sports betting and gaming platform built for a new wave of players.
 We combine sharp product thinking, bold brand, and fast execution to create experiences that feel modern, intuitive, and built for how people actually play today.
 Over 400,000 players have already made the move, and we’re only just getting started.
 We’re a high-performance team operating at pace. High ownership. Constant iteration. No hiding behind processes. We move quickly, test relentlessly, and turn ambitious ideas into real impact. If you’re driven, creative, and thrive in fast-moving environments where you can shape meaningful outcomes - keep reading.
 Not your grandad’s bookie.
 👀 The Role 
 Title: Lead Product Manager 
 Team: Product 
 Location: United Kingdom, Remote
 Our core team powers the experiences every Midnite customer relies on - from onboarding, verification and payments to account management, safer gambling and support. As our products and markets grow, we’re looking for a Lead Product Manager to own complex problems across this foundation, bringing deep expertise in regulated customer journeys.
 You’ll own strategy and roadmaps across a customer-facing Core UX team and a Core Internal team covering integrations, back-office tools and operational capabilities. Working closely with Engineering, Design and Compliance, you’ll turn complex regulatory needs into intuitive customer experiences and effective internal products.
 This is not a requirements-delivery role. You’ll bring a strong product voice, challenge assumptions constructively and find better ways to achieve regulatory outcomes without unnecessary friction. Your early focus will be supporting international expansion, with the opportunity to develop deeper ownership of compliance journeys over time. You’ll be a Core Product Manager first, ready to lead wherever the biggest problems and opportunities arise.
 You will: 
 Own strategy, discovery, roadmaps and delivery across your Core UX and Core Internal teams, turning priorities into clear problem statements, PRDs and measurable outcomes.

 Shape regulated customer journeys across KYC, verification, affordability, safer gambling and player limits, balancing regulatory requirements with customer experience.

 Partner closely with Compliance to understand the required outcome, challenge assumptions and develop better solutions rather than simply implementing requests.

 Improve the internal systems, integrations, back-office tooling and automation that support Compliance and operational teams.

 Work with your Engineering Lead and Designer through our Three Amigos model, collaborating with Data, Player Support and other stakeholders to solve cross-functional problems.

 Support international market expansion by building reusable capabilities that can adapt to local requirements rather than solving the same problem repeatedly.

 Prioritise ruthlessly, make confident decisions and use feedback and data to improve customer, operational and commercial outcomes.

 Champion AI-native ways of working, identifying thoughtful opportunities for AI and automation while helping shape how Core evolves as Midnite scales.

 The next Midniter: 
 Has 8+ years’ Product Management experience, with ownership of complex products in a highly regulated environment and experience in a high-growth or startup business.

 Brings hands-on expertise in KYC, identity verification, affordability, AML, safer gambling, player limits or similar risk and compliance products. Fintech, banking and financial services experience is highly relevant; gambling experience is a bonus, not a requirement.

 Has built strong relationships with Compliance, Risk, Legal or operational teams and can translate regulatory complexity into clear product strategy.

 Challenges stakeholders constructively, explains product trade-offs clearly and takes confident ownership of decisions while respecting regulatory obligations.

 Can balance customer experience, operational efficiency and commercial outcomes across both customer-facing journeys and internal capabilities.

 Communicates clearly with technical and non-technical audiences, prioritises effectively and stays proactive when responsibilities and team structures evolve.

 Uses AI to improve their own effectiveness and identifies considered opportunities for AI and automation in products and operations.

 Brings intellectual honesty, curiosity and self-awareness, with a commitment to learning, improving and sharing expertise.

 Private health insurance with zero excess, including optical cover and optional dental.

 Income protection to protect your earnings and give you peace of mind.

 Tenure holiday policy. After three years you receive an extra two days leave, increasing to 30 days annually after five years.

 Flexible working and a fully supported home office setup so you can do your best work from home.

jobs.title: Product Manager (English/French)
jobs.description:
About Unframe

Unframe is an AI-first startup helping the world’s largest enterprises bring LLM-powered applications to life in days - not months. We combine the speed of a product company with the flexibility of a consultancy, helping customers move from idea to deployed AI systems faster than anyone else in the market.

Backed by Bessemer, Craft, and TLV Partners with $100M in Series B funding, we’re building a fast-growing, revenue-generating company working with Fortune 500 customers globally

About the role

This role sits on the front line: you engage directly with enterprise clients, lead discovery to uncover core business challenges, and design and ship tailored AI solutions built on Unframe's platform. You own the work end-to-end, serving as the strategic and technical bridge from initial conversation through to final deployment.

This is a true builder role. You write the precise specifications and prompt architectures that bring solutions to life, making the critical design decisions that determine whether an enterprise AI deployment actually succeeds.

What you’ll do

This is a project-led role with unmediated access to clients at every stage. You will typically manage several engagements simultaneously, with short planning horizons and evolving requirements. Roughly 30 to 40 percent of the role is active client management, ensuring senior stakeholders remain aligned through delivery, progress reviews, and post-deployment rollouts.

    • Lead Enterprise Discovery: Conduct discovery sessions directly with enterprise clients to map workflows, uncover business challenges, and distinguish surface-level requests from fundamental operational needs.
    • Design & Spec AI Solutions: Translate customer problems into structured solution plans on Unframe's platform. Write detailed specs and define prompt and context structures, owning the complete solution design.
    • Drive End-to-End Delivery: Collaborate with engineers and AI specialists to deliver solutions on target. Prioritize requirements and manage tradeoffs across speed, stability, and scope.
    • Represent the User & Platform: Act as the voice of enterprise operators and domain experts while collaborating with the Platform team to identify reusable product patterns.

What we’re looking for

  • 4+ years of experience in product management or technical delivery roles, with a proven track record working alongside engineering teams on complex, fast-paced technical products.
  • Bilingual Fluency (English & French): Fluent in French to connect with users and stakeholders in France, and fluent in English for daily collaboration across our international teams.
  • Customer-Led Discovery: Proven experience personally leading consultative conversations with enterprise buyers and operators - not supporting a sales call, not interviewing platform users, but owning the conversation to surface unstated needs and translate them into clear solution scope.
  • Enterprise Stakeholder Management: Ability to manage senior client relationships through a complex delivery; keeping stakeholders aligned, navigating competing priorities, and being the primary point of contact when requirements shift or timelines compress.
  • Problem-to-Solution Design: Ability to start from a raw business problem without existing features for reference, defining exactly how an AI solution should function and writing precise specs for build teams.
  • Complex Delivery Execution: Experience shipping AI-powered features under tight timelines, managing evolving requirements, and documenting strategic tradeoffs.
  • AI Solutions Experience: Direct exposure to building with LLMs - writing prompt structures, defining context and output constraints, working with agentic systems, or managing model uncertainty in a shipped product or working prototype. This is the dimension most learnable on the job; concrete work product carries more weight than certification.
  • Builder Orientation: Driven by creating customer-facing solutions rather than simply managing traditional roadmaps or processing requests.
  • Core Competencies: Strong written communication, systems thinking, high attention to detail, fluent English (written and verbal), and the ability to navigate multi-faceted projects.

Location

Remote (France): This position is 100%

jobs.title: Product Manager | Toxic
jobs.description:
Legal AI is zo goed als de kennis erachter, en aan die kennis bouwen we bij Lefebvre Sdu al 200 jaar. Dag in, dag uit. Wet voor wet. Woord voor woord. Dat doen we zo zorgvuldig dat andere legal AI-tools op onze data en software draaien. Vanuit ons Nederlandse kantoor bouwen we daarnaast voor Lefebvre Group, de Europese leider in juridische en fiscale kennis, ons eigen platform: GenIA-L, dat in Europa inmiddels goed is voor meer dan 100 miljoen euro ARR. Ruim 75.000 professionals werken er dagelijks mee, en we bouwen het op de standaard die hun vak vraagt. We zoeken een Product Manager die Sdu Toxic laat groeien met proposities waar klanten aantoonbaar iets aan hebben.
 
 HOE JIJ ONS VERDER BRENGT 
 Sdu Toxic is de meest complete SaaS-oplossing voor wet- en regelgeving rond gevaarlijke stoffen in Nederland. Organisaties registreren er hun gevaarlijke stoffen mee, beoordelen blootstelling, leggen maatregelen vast en informeren hun medewerkers. Zo helpen we QHSE-professionals om mensen veiliger te laten werken en aan de arbowetgeving te voldoen. Achter Toxic staat een team met diepgaande kennis van chemische producten en de regels die erbij horen. Die expertise maakt het product sterk. Jouw opdracht is zorgen dat de markt dat ook ziet en ervoor kiest. Je krijgt de regie over een grote en diverse marktgroep met stevige commerciële ambities. Op basis van marktdata en klantinzichten bepaal je welke producten we ontwikkelen, wat erin zit, hoe we ze positioneren en via welke kanalen we ze in de markt zetten. Samen met de Pricing Specialist bepaal je de prijsstrategie. Je laat klanten valideren wat je bouwt en vertaalt hun feedback naar productontwikkeling en een commerciële aanpak. Bij grote en complexe klanten zie je kansen, en je bouwt strategische samenwerkingen op met klanten en partners zoals softwarebedrijven. Omzet, gebruik, verlengingen en klanttevredenheid houd je scherp in de gaten, en je stuurt bij waar dat nodig is. Innovaties die je voor Toxic ontwikkelt, kunnen breder binnen Lefebvre Sdu worden ingezet. Je bent sparringpartner van de Head of Innovation en coacht onze Product Marketeers in hun go-to-market aanpak. De kennis is er. Het product staat. Jij bepaalt hoe Toxic groeit.
 
 DIT ZOEKEN WIJ 
 Je combineert diepgaand marktinzicht met de daadkracht om iets nieuws op te bouwen, van klantvalidatie en positionering tot go-to-market en marktintroductie. Je krijgt mensen uit verschillende disciplines mee op inhoud en visie, en je pakt kansen op, ook als de aanpak nog niet vaststaat. Dit zoeken wij ook:
 Je hebt eerder verantwoordelijkheid gedragen voor producten, proposities of go-to-market in een complexe markt of klantgroep.

 Je hebt producten ontwikkeld én succesvol in de markt gezet.

 Je vertaalt marktontwikkelingen en klantbehoeften naar een heldere langetermijnvisie en concrete commerciële kansen.

 Je combineert commercieel inzicht met data en gebruikt resultaten om producten steeds scherper te maken.

 Je verbindt collega's uit product, IT, sales, marketing, content en customer support.

 Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

 
 HIER TEKEN JE VOOR 
 Je krijgt de regie over producten die bepalend zijn voor de groei van Sdu Toxic. Van markt- en klantinzicht tot positionering, prijs en go-to-market: jij brengt alles samen. Je hebt volop ruimte om innovaties Lefebvre Sdu-breed uit te bouwen, strategische partnerships aan te gaan en zichtbaar impact te maken op omzet, klantwaarde en groei. Vanaf dag 1 heb je invloed op hoe kennis wordt ingezet bij duizenden professionals in Nederland. Dit krijg je ook:
 Een salaris tussen €5.508 en €6.458 per maand, op basis van een standaard werkweek van 36 uur.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
INDG builds the systems behind large-scale visual content production. We turn physical products into digital twins, CGI content, interactive experiences, and automated product visuals for global brands that need quality, consistency, and scale. 
 
 As Senior Project Manager , you own the delivery rhythm for complex client programs where design, 3D production, development, review cycles, vendors, and brand requirements all meet. You are not just moving tasks across a board. You are structuring how work gets made, reviewed, approved, and shipped. 
 
 This role exists because INDG’s clients are asking for more than isolated CGI assets. They need repeatable production models: one source product model, many outputs, controlled visual quality, reliable timelines, and clear communication across teams. You will help build that operating layer. 
 
 You’ll manage projects in Consumer Products or Healthcare , where product accuracy, visual consistency, compliance, and delivery discipline matter. The outcome is clear: clients receive production-grade interactive experiences and 3D content that can scale across campaigns, platforms, markets, and product lines. 
 
 What You Will Do 
 Own complex delivery from kickoff to launch 
You’ll manage multiple interactive and CGI-driven projects at the same time, from scope definition through final delivery. You’ll translate client goals into timelines, resource plans, review flows, dependencies, and delivery milestones. You’ll know when a project is blocked by missing product data, unresolved art direction, technical debt, unclear feedback, or vendor capacity. 

 Connect clients, artists, developers, and vendors 
You’ll be the operating link between client teams, CG artists, designers, developers, producers, vendors, and agencies. You’ll make sure everyone understands what is being built, what quality bar applies, what decisions are pending, and what needs to happen next. You’ll keep communication specific, written, and actionable. 

 Build delivery systems, not one-off project plans 
You’ll improve how projects run. That can mean standardizing intake, tightening feedback loops, clarifying approval gates, improving Jira or project documentation, reducing manual handoffs, or creating better reporting for client and internal teams. You’ll look for repeatable patterns in CGI, digital twin, and interactive delivery and turn them into cleaner ways of working. 

 Protect visual quality while managing constraints 
You’ll understand that delivery is not complete because the file was exported. It is complete when the output meets the brief, the product is accurate, the interaction works, the render quality holds up, and the client can use it confidently. You’ll help teams balance scope, timing, budget, technical limitations, and visual ambition without hiding tradeoffs. 

 
 Who You Are

jobs.description:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous! 
 Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains. 
 Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times. 
 To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies. 
 BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America. 
 Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard. 
 
 
 Location 
 This is a full-time position based in Munich or Cologne. Following a comprehensive onboarding period at our HQ in central Zurich (minimum one month), you will work from your home location, with regular visits to customers across the DACH region.
 Team collaboration matters a lot to us. You will regularly spend time with the team in person, in Zurich and at our hubs, for team days, all-hands and offsites. These visits are financially supported by blp.
 
 Your Mission 
 You get customers live. Hands on, end to end, and fast.
 As a Senior Project Manager , you make large, global blp transformations happen. These programs touch finance, procurement and supply chain at once, run across multiple ERP systems and legal entities, and roll out country by country. Your job is to orchestrate all of it and get the customer live: the first go-live above all, because that is where credibility is won or lost, and then wave after wave with the same discipline. You run the steering committee, you lead a blp team on each engagement, and you do that across several engagements at once.
 At both levels, scope is the single biggest lever on whether a project goes live on time. Protecting it is a daily job, not a contract clause. You escalate early and precisely rather than absorbing problems until they become critical.
 You will not be alone with the technical side. Integrations Engineers handle the connection into the ERP, Technical Project Managers handle the harder solution design, and our Consultants take over the automation work after go-live. On our largest strategic accounts a Client Partner carries the relationship and the commercial number, so your attention goes to delivery quality.
 We have done this many times, so you are not inventing the approach each time. A proven onboarding method and a strong toolkit are what let you carry your own customers from early on.
 
 Your Career Path in Project Management 
 This is the path most of our delivery leadership came through, and we hire at every step of it. We place you according to your experience and the size of the programs you have delivered, and we are explicit about what the next step requires.
 Project Manager: You get customers live end to end, several in parallel: guided onboarding for commercial customers, leading enterprise projects yourself, or a workstream on our largest programs. Typically you bring 2+ years in consulting, implementation or project management. 

 Senior Project Manager: You make large, global transformations happen: multiple ERPs, entities and countries, the steering committee, and a blp team on each engagement. Typically you bring 5+ years delivering complex, multi-country programs. 

 Next steps: Lead a delivery team, or move into Consulting and from there towards our Client Partner role on strategic accounts.

 Moves into Consulting or Customer Success Engineering are open at every level, and many of our people make them.
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 Run implementations end to end: kick-off, scope, planning, configuration, testing and go-live.

 Manage several customers in parallel at different stages, and keep every one of them on date.

 Work with customers on their processes, and flag early where a process assumption will not hold.

 Coordinate the specialists on your projects: Integrations Engineers, Technical Project Managers and AI Automation Specialists.

 Keep the project inside its budget, and raise it early when the effort is drifting.

 Hand over cleanly at go-live to our Consultants and support organization.

 In addition, as a Senior Project Manager 
 Own the delivery outcome of global programs from kick-off to the last go-live: plan, scope, dependencies and date.

 Drive the first go-live relentlessly, then run wave planning across ERPs, entities and countries.

jobs.description:
About Linro 
 Linro is a Berlin-based cloud security company building a real-time, agentic cloud-security platform. Teams ship with AI. AI ships with Linro. 
 Infrastructure changes constantly, and increasingly it's AI agents making the changes. Tools that scan snapshots and flag risk after the fact can't keep up. Linro enforces intended state across the whole lifecycle instead, from commit to runtime: MCP and pre-commit hooks at commit time, blast-radius simulation that blocks bad changes before they ship, and real-time detection, enforcement and auto-remediation in production. Most tools tell you what's wrong. Linro stops it.
 We have each been on the receiving end of this problem: Running cloud security at scale, building the platforms underneath it, and shipping in regulated systems where a wrong change isn't an option. Founded in Berlin in 2026 and built fully remote across Europe, Linro has a platform that's real and working, with plenty still to shape.
 
 The role 
 You would be our first dedicated product manager, working closely with the founders and the engineering team. You decide what we build next and in which order, across the whole product, and you ground those decisions in regular conversations with customers, from the first discovery call to the roadmap review.  What you will do 
 Talk to customers and prospects yourself (CISOs, security and platform leads): run discovery calls, demo what exists, take the objections and turn feedback into a clear, ordered roadmap.

 Translate what customers need into clear requirements for engineers, including how our guardrails should behave when the user is an AI coding agent: tool design, failure modes, and what an agent may change on its own.

 Own releases end to end: plan them with engineering, define what done means, write clear release notes and make sure customers understand what changed and why.

 Be the product voice in front of customers: join sales and buyer calls, present the roadmap and handle security and compliance questions (e.g. SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI). Set success metrics and launch criteria.

 What we are looking for 
 5+ years as a product manager (or a founder or engineer who moved into product) on B2B infrastructure, security or developer products sold to enterprises.

 Technical fluency. You can read a Terraform plan, you have a solid grasp of databases and SQL, you understand APIs at least at a high level, and you hold your own with engineers on trade-offs.

 Hands-on customer discovery. Customer interviews and pilots you ran yourself, and a record of turning that into a few sharp bets instead of a long list.

 Prioritization and written clarity. A record of ranking competing demands with a small engineering team, using explicit criteria, and of explaining those trade-offs clearly to customers and founders. Specs and decision memos that stand on their own.

 You know the buyer: CISOs and platform leads. You are comfortable in front of customers and executives: you can run a discovery call, a demo or a roadmap session on your own and earn the room. You can map features to compliance frameworks at product level, not auditor level.

 Zero-to-one product work at an early-stage startup.

 We work remotely across Europe. We get the whole team together in person somewhere in Europe once a quarter for a few days.  Data and customer insight. You do your own analysis, from funnels to test read-outs, and combine it with research and interviews to find the real problem.

 Hands-on attitude, comfortable using AI. You build and launch things yourself — landing pages, tests and prototypes — and use AI to automate your workflows.

 Nice-to-have

 Experience in a subscription business: trials, paywalls, pricing, churn and LTV dynamics

 Familiarity with tools such as Braze, Contentful, Google Analytics or Webflow

 Experience in a scale-up or PE-backed environment

 German language skills

 
 Benefits 
 Success requires positive energy. That's why we ensure the right conditions are in place — physically, mentally, and within the team:

Description Legal AI content is turning into a commodity. Every vendor ships the same AI-generated blog posts and the same generic battlecards. We are transitioning into an AI-native company ourselves, and that changes what this role has to be. You would sit in the marketing department with a dotted line to the product department, but not as a traditional product marketer who ships a few blog posts and calls it enablement. Not as a pure thinker who never touches a sales deck. Instead, as one person who owns our voice and turns it into everything the company needs to win: the thesis that gets us cited, the sales slide that closes next week’s deal, and the briefing that gets a General Counsel to say yes. 
 You will use AI tooling and agents to cover ground that used to take a small team, so you can spend your own time on the part that cannot be delegated: the thinking, the judgment, and the writing that actually changes someone’s mind. 

 Your mission 1. Product Marketing & Market Intelligence  
 Drive go-to-market impact for launches and expansion, from plan to execution. 

 Own deep knowledge of our ICP and competitive landscape, and feed it back into the product and sales strategy. 

 Bring market and customer truth back to Product so we build what actually matters. 

 Work across Product, Marketing, Sales and leadership. You don’t sit in a silo. 

 2. Positioning, Narrative & Thought Leadership  
 Own positioning: define what Legartis stands for, against which alternatives, for which buyer. 

 Develop and defend clear, evidence-backed points of view on where Legal AI is going. Not generic AI-created opinions, but real positions based on customer and buyer research (interviews with General Counsel, CFOs, legal operations leaders). 

 Conceive flagship studies and thought leadership content. Direct AI tools to help you scale production while you own the substance and the voice. 

 Own our thought leadership channels, including video, and decide what gets said. Write what can’t be delegated: founder posts, executive bylines, keynote scripts, board-level memos. 

 3. Sales & Customer-Facing Enablement  
 Build the sales slides, briefings, one-pagers and competitive battlecards that make Sales and Customer Success more effective in every conversation. 

 Translate positioning and research into materials for specific deals, verticals and executive-level conversations. 

 Work directly with Sales and CS to find out what’s missing in the field. Build case studies and customer proof points that Sales actually uses, not ones that sit in a folder. 

 What We Want to Achieve Together 
 In 6 months: a flagship study that gets cited by competitors and customers. Sales armed with materials that actually get used in deals. A clear Legartis position that everyone in the company can repeat in 30 seconds. 
 In 12 months: Legartis recognized as one of the leading European voices on Legal AI, with a content and enablement engine, you plus the AI tools you direct, that outproduces companies with five times the headcount. 

 Your profile Proven strategist: demonstrated success creating and executing marketing strategies. 

 Storyteller: you craft compelling materials about complex AI products for non-technical audiences. 

 Clear communicator: exceptional written and verbal communication with a strong visual sensibility. 

 Impact-driven: comfortable with experimentation and interpreting both quantitative and qualitative data.

 A track record where writing and thinking were central: journalism, industry or analyst research, strategy consulting, or senior product marketing with real strategic ownership. 4+ years in marketing, product marketing or a comparable strategic role at a SaaS company. Classic PMM experience (positioning, GTM, enablement) is a strong plus, not a hard requirement, if your thinking and writing are strong enough. 

 Fluent German and English, executive-level writing in both. 

 

 Why us? Real editorial ownership over our voice and our position, not a content calendar handed down from someone else.

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager (Efector Development)
jobs.description:
As Destinus scales its vehicle programmes, we are looking for a dedicated Technical Project Manager to own execution across the full vehicle development stack – from propulsion and structures through avionics integration, ground support equipment, and qualification. This frees our engineers to focus on technical depth and our team leads on strategic leadership.
 As one of the first hires in this group, you will manage a programme and help build the PM structure itself alongside team leads and fellow TPMs. You own execution – schedule, cross-disciplinary coordination, risk, and delivery. The engineers run the technical depth; you run the programme.
 What You’ll Do 
 · Own end-to-end execution of vehicle-level and subsystem product development programmes – from kick-off through hardware build, test campaigns, qualification, and delivery
 · Build and maintain programme plans spanning propulsion, structures, avionics, systems engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and regulatory dependencies; identify and resolve critical path risks early
 · Run programme reviews and cross-functional coordination meetings; keep decisions documented and actions closed
 · Work closely with engineering leads across disciplines to track technical progress and translate it into clear programme status
 · Coordinate system integration activities – ensuring interfaces between subsystems (propulsion, structures, avionics, GSE) are managed, dependencies tracked, and integration milestones owned
 · Manage external dependencies: supplier lead times, test facility scheduling, regulatory submissions, and customer milestones
 · Proactively flag scope creep, resource conflicts, and schedule risk to leadership – with options, not just problems
 · Contribute to building the PM structure, tools, and ways of working for the department alongside team leads and fellow TPMs
 Requirements 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in aerospace, mechanical, systems, or a related engineering discipline
 · 5–8 years in a hardware-heavy development environment; at least 2 in a project management, programme coordination, or technical lead role – career PMs without hardware exposure will not be considered
 · Background in aerospace, defence, or a similarly regulated hardware domain; familiarity with vehicle-level or system-level development and qualification cycles is essential
 · Experience managing cross-disciplinary programmes spanning multiple engineering domains (structures, propulsion, avionics, or similar) is a strong advantage
 · Able to manage multiple concurrent projects across engineering, manufacturing, procurement, and testing
 · Strong systems thinking – able to see the full picture, spot where the hard problems are likely to sit, and know when to dive into detail without losing the overall programme
 · Strong planning skills – able to build a programme schedule from scratch, identify critical path, and keep it current
 · Comfortable building structure in an ambiguous environment; pragmatic over bureaucratic
 · Clear, direct communicator in English; German is an advantage

Data & Performance

  • Arbitrate and prioritize backlog based on data driven decision 

Product Mindset & Culture

  • Serve as an ambassador for product excellence and taxonomy standards across Decathlon’s global network.
  • Foster a collaborative work environment based on trust, accountability, and user-centric decision-making.

PROFILE

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager in a fast-paced B2C e-commerce, digital platform, or catalog/search ecosystem.
  • Domain Expertise: Strong understanding of e-commerce navigation, catalog treeviews, taxonomy/metadata structures, or search & discovery platforms.

 Strategic ownership: Define the Public API strategy and roadmap for a product that already powers our integrations, MCP and Qonto Embed, and decide where to take it next.

 Meaningful, high-stakes impact: Make the API a reliable foundation for connectivity, helping Connect grow for our active customers.

 Platform thinking: Define a shared framework so that every Qonto team can build and expose its endpoints consistently, and partners can self-serve.

 Cross-functional leadership: Partner with PMs and engineering managers across Qonto to align on priorities and get API needs onto their roadmaps.

 
 🤔 What you can expect 

 
 Market context: The Public API is no longer just integrations. It now also powers MCP and Qonto Embed, so complexity grows fast and we need one person fully focused on its strategy.

 Team: You join the Connect team of 3 PMs (marketplace and bank aggregation, integrations, Public API), working with an engineering team that mixes backend and low-code engineers.

 The first question on your desk : what works well and what needs improvement in the Public API, how does each consumer of the API fit in, and what is our next bet in terms of use case tu enable and push via API.

 Tools: You work with the public API documentation (open to partners without a Qonto account), the developer portal, and AI tools. Being comfortable opening the docs or the code is part of the job.

 Rituals: a daily product and tech sync by scope, a Monday product weekly with peers, a Friday debrief to share wins and struggles, and a Monthly Connect showcase of results and new features.

 
 🏅 About you 

 
 Experience: You have solid product management experience and are comfortable owning a product that every other team contributes to, with a roadmap you have to build and defend yourself.

 API and technical sensitivity (a plus): You have worked on an API, integration, platform or developer-facing product, or you learn technical topics fast. You’re comfortable getting hands-on with API documentation and working closely with engineers.

 Stakeholder management and influence: You have aligned several teams around a shared product without hierarchical authority. You communicate clearly with PMs, engineers and senior stakeholders, and you consider the impact of your plan on every team before pushing it.

 Nice to have: Fintech, payments or partner-integration background, and curiosity for AI tools and vibe coding (we learn it together at Qonto).

jobs.title: Product Design Lead
jobs.description:
Fuel50 is a workforce transformation platform helping organisations understand workforce capability, build skills and enable internal mobility in an AI-driven world. Our products combine skills intelligence, talent marketplace experiences and responsible AI to help people and organisations take their next step.Â 
 We are looking for a Product Design Lead to shape the next chapter of our product experience and design organisation.Â 
 This is a senior player-coach role. You will lead and develop our product design team while staying close to the work, setting direction, shaping product strategy, prototyping ideas and helping teams ship high-quality experiences.Â 
 You will work closely with Product and Engineering as a leadership trio, influencing decisions across the organisation and helping Fuel50 build products that are simple, trusted and valuable.Â 
 If youâre a strategic design leader who still loves getting close to the work, developing people and shipping real product, weâd love to hear from you!Â 
What you'll do: Lead, manage and coach our product designers, supporting their growth and helping them reach their next level.Â 
 Set and communicate a clear product design vision across Fuel50's skills intelligence, talent mobility and AI-powered experiences, and tell the story of where our products are going in a way that excites customers, colleagues and leadership.Â 
 Own the design direction without waiting for it to be handed to you. Spot opportunities, form a point of view, and prototype ideas to make them tangible.Â 
 Bring a strong point of view to senior conversations, challenge assumptions constructively and influence decisions across the business.Â 
 Partner with Product and Engineering from discovery through to delivery, balancing customer value, design quality, technical reality and pace.Â 
 Design human-centred AI experiences with appropriate trust, explainability, user control and clear handoffs, including agent and assistant experiences that work across multiple surfaces such as the Fuel50 platform, Microsoft Teams and Copilot.Â 
 Grow our design engineering capability, and be comfortable building and shipping working prototypes or code yourself.Â 
 Evolve our design system, accessibility standards (including WCAG compliance) and design-to-code practices so Fuel50 feels coherent and high quality across every product.Â 
 Shape design team structure, capability, hiring, planning and ways of working as the organisation evolves.Â 
 
What you'll bring: Experience in product design in a SaaS or technology environment (we suggest 7 or more years), including at least 2 years leading, managing or coaching designers, and a track record of building healthy, high-performing teams.Â 
 Strong product design craft across discovery, interaction design, visual design, prototyping, research and shipped digital products.Â 
 Experience designing complex, connected systems and journeys for multiple personas, ideally in an enterprise or B2B product.Â 
 The ability to think big and set a compelling vision, while staying pragmatic about what can be learned and shipped next.Â 
 The ability to originate ideas and direction, and to communicate them clearly through stories, prototypes and design narrative.Â 
 Confidence working with experienced senior stakeholders and influencing through clarity, judgement and strong communication.Â 
 Experience working closely with Product and Engineering as a genuine cross-functional trio.Â 
 Technical fluency and a willingness to get into the code. You should be comfortable building working prototypes using HTML, CSS, JavaScript or similar tools, and have contributed code that has shipped to production, for example front-end changes or design system components submitted through pull requests.Â 
 Hands-on experience using AI coding and design tools, such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, to prototype faster and ship real work. We want someone who uses these tools well and can show how they have changed the way their team works.Â 
 Working knowledge of accessibility and WCAG. You have designed to WCAG standards, tested for it, and built accessibility into your team's design system and review process.Â 
 An interest in design systems and data-informed decision-making.Â 
 You do not need to tick every box. We care about the quality of your thinking, the way you work with people and your ability to turn ambitious ideas into better product experiences.Â 

 All Fuellies are a core part of our culture and making Fuel50 an amazing place to work. Some additional benefits are:Â Â 
 A day off on your birthday and your Fuel50 anniversaryÂ 
 A âReFuel Dayâ once a quarter to relax and refuelÂ 
 Remote work and flexible work times - we're supportive of school commitments, traveling in off-peak hours, and attending to lifeâs eventsÂ 
 A progressive parental leave policyÂ 
 Comprehensive fully subsidised health insurance with Southern CrossÂ

jobs.title: Agentic Product Manager
jobs.description:
About us: 
 Founded by former Google search engineers with PhDs in AI from ETH Zurich, DeepJudge helps legal teams unlock and apply the knowledge inside their organizations through world-class enterprise search and AI infrastructure – enabling them to automate workflows, build knowledge-powered applications, and turn institutional knowledge into a lasting advantage.
 Every organization can license the same AI models, but no two organizations share the same institutional knowledge. Decades of experience, work product, and precedent are often fragmented across systems, underused, and inaccessible. DeepJudge makes this expertise instantly available and actionable – helping legal teams find the right information faster, surface relevant knowledge, and apply it where it matters most.
 Our platform is trusted by many of the world’s leading law firms and legal teams, including Holland & Knight, Gunderson Dettmer, Cozen O’Connor, ArentFox Schiff, CMS Switzerland, Schoenherr, and others.
 Headquartered in Switzerland with a growing team across North America and Europe, DeepJudge is shaping the future of how professional knowledge is discovered and applied.
 At DeepJudge, we move with urgency, think rigorously, and work closely with our clients to build products that solve meaningful problems. If you want to help define how AI transforms professional knowledge work, we’d love to hear from you. 

About the role: 
 We’re looking for a hands-on and strategically minded Product Manager to take the reins of our assistant surfaces and agent harness at DeepJudge. You’ll play a critical role in shaping the present and future of our platform by driving immediate impact across our go-to-market priorities while also thinking deeply about where we go next.
 This is an opportunity to lead product in a high-caliber environment where you're empowered to innovate, move fast, and deliver real value to legal professionals at some of the most sophisticated law firms and legal departments in the world. This is an on-site role based in Zurich. You will report to the Head of Product.
 We’re not building another AI wrapper. We’re building a product with real depth, differentiated by data access, search engine expertise, and deep customer understanding. Chat is quickly becoming the interface of choice, and we’re now moving towards long-horizon agentic tasks – right at the cutting edge of what’s proven in the market. We’re looking for someone who thrives in ambiguity, is energized by the opportunity to create, and knows how to “cook from scratch” — not just follow the norm . 
 
 Your responsibilities will include: 
 Own product strategy, roadmap and execution across our Agentic Surfaces and Harness, powering DeepJudge’s advanced AI reasoning features, with a strong focus on prioritization, user impact, and business value

 Evolve our chat interface to make sure the user experience is the best fit for our target use cases

 Prioritize feature requests across customers, vertical product areas and new strategic initiatives, balancing short-term go-to-market optimization with long-term discovery and strategic vision

 Evolve our evaluation datasets and infrastructure to continuously improve our ability to take launch decisions with confidence

 Assess the speed, quality and cost profile of model or harness changes and drive decision-making across tech and product leadership

 Proactively identify new technologies and follow the latest agentic AI trends to drive efficiency and performance of complex, long-horizon tasks

 Work directly with engineering leads to define and ship high-quality features fast

 Collaborate with Design and Product Marketing to craft delightful and intuitive user experiences

 Engage deeply with customers and prospects to gather insights, validate ideas, and translate feedback into roadmap priorities – combining direct feedback with scaled usage analysis to understand how our products are used, and sharing those learnings across the organization

 Lead cross-functional initiatives that drive adoption, engagement, and measurable value for our users

 Take ownership of product decision-making across our agentic product area

 
 You're a great fit if you: 
 Have strong product instincts and 5+ years of experience in digital product management, with a track record of building and launching impactful B2B SaaS products

 Have hands-on experience building and shipping agentic applications and RAG systems – going beyond basic chatbot or AI workflow features

 Have a deep understanding of agent evaluation techniques and have built or evolved evaluation datasets and processes before

 Are familiar with the latest agentic AI trends and concepts – and keep following them

 Are comfortable leading in a dynamic, fast-paced environment — from writing specs to running discovery calls to shipping fast

 Think holistically about user problems, systems, and long-term platform value

 Are humble, curious, and opinionated in the right ways —

jobs.title: Product Manager (Atomic Team)
jobs.description:
About us 
 Smallpdf was founded in 2013 with one simple belief: working with documents shouldn’t be complicated. Today, we’re an industry leader in digital document solutions, trusted by millions of users across 195+ countries. We build intuitive, powerful tools that help individuals and businesses work smarter with their documents. From compressing and converting files to editing and e-signing, our platform makes complex document workflows simple, secure, and accessible.
 As a product-led company headquartered in Switzerland and powered by a diverse, global team from 35+ countries, we combine product excellence with a strong focus on user experience, data-driven decision-making and continuous innovation. We operate at the intersection of simplicity and performance, building scalable solutions that power everyday productivity for individuals and businesses alike. Our team is driven by ownership, experimentation and a shared commitment to delivering meaningful impact at scale.
 About the role 
 Over 60 million people use Smallpdf every month to do one thing: compress a file, convert it, translate it, merge it. Our core tools are freemium and SEO-led: people find us through Google and, more and more, through AI assistants. They finish the job and leave.
 As Product Manager for our core tools, you make that single task the fastest, easiest and best on the market, so search engines, AI assistants and people send users back. You own the individual tools end to end. Together with our growth team, you work on the channels that bring people to them: organic search, paid search and AI search. You work in Zurich with a fully staffed product team, including an EM, a designer and engineering counterparts, and closely with our SEO, growth and marketing teams.
 Responsibilities 
 Own the individual tools end to end: upload experience, processing, output quality, download

 Work with our SEO, SEM and growth teams on how people reach the tools, including positioning with marketing so people remember us by name

 Help turn AI search and LLMs into a real acquisition channel, from first users to a tracked source of traffic

 Ship AI features where they help users, with a clear process for accuracy, cost and quality before launch

 Design, monitor and analyse experiments on millions of sessions, and ship, iterate or kill on the result

 Run deep analyses and user research yourself, and be the voice of the user in every decision

 Set the strategy and roadmap for your area from user feedback, data and business goals, with a commercial case, cost and outcome metrics for every bet

 Align engineering, design, SEO, growth, marketing and other product teams on what ships and why

 Lead without authority: manage up with clear recommendations, settle ownership with peer teams, and present plans and results to leadership and the whole company

 Raise the bar around you: help your team own product decisions, give and take honest feedback, coach others, and step outside the PM role when it moves the needle

 About you 
 6+ years in product management

 Hands-on A/B testing experience on a product with real traffic

 AI in your daily work: workflows, analysis, prototyping, research. You know where it goes wrong and you check it

 Experience defining need & quality for an AI feature, or a clear view of how you would do it

 Comfortable talking with engineers about trade-offs, speed, errors and estimations

 Dynamic and hands-on: you make quick decisions based on real data

 Comfortable with ambiguity: you find the problem worth solving when nobody has named it yet

 Curious and rigorous: you dig into the data yourself until the answer holds

 You run user research yourself, and bring what you learn into decisions

 Commercially minded: you know what a feature is worth before you build it

 A clear communicator who aligns people without needing authority, with excellent written and spoken English

 Nice to have 
 Document or file-processing products

 A utility business with a strong free tier

 Experience with high-volume consumer tools

 Experience with SEO, SEM or AI search as acquisition channels

 Important note: this is a hybrid role based in our Zurich office. You either already live in the Zurich area or are willing to relocate. 
 
 Join Smallpdf - Where innovation meets impact! 
 Becoming part of our team means more than just taking a job - it’s joining a dynamic, collaborative environment where your voice matters, your growth is championed, and your work truly makes a difference.
 Here, we don’t just talk about a growth mindset - we live it. You’ll thrive in a culture that balances professional ambition with personal well-being, where flexibility, creativity, and purpose come together. Whether you're shaping the future through groundbreaking projects or leveling up your skills, your journey here will be one of impact, innovation, and continuous learning. This reflects in our company values .
 
 Our Benefits 
 🌍 You get to impact

jobs.description:
Product Manager - Categories (h/f/x)

Localisation : Paris, France

Domaine : E-Commerce Solutions — Navigate & Categories

À PROPOS DE DECATHLON & DU DOMAINE E-COMMERCE

Decathlon accélère sa transformation digitale avec pour mission de devenir la plateforme digitale du sport qui permet à nos clients de découvrir notre univers à travers des expériences locales, axées sur le sport et omnicanales.

Notre Mission : Faire bouger les gens à travers le sport pour rendre le bien-être accessible à tous.

En rejoignant ce périmètre, vous travaillerez au sein du domaine E-Commerce Solutions. Nos équipes transforment et déploient la navigation e-commerce mondiale, les arborescences de catalogue ainsi que les moteurs de catégorisation back-end visant à faciliter la découverte et l'accès à la totalité de l'offre Decathlon (produits, services et informations).

REJOIGNEZ LA SQUAD CATEGORIES

Rattaché(e) au Group Product Manager (E-Commerce / Navigate), vous prendrez la responsabilité de la squad Categories. Vous travaillerez aux côtés d'une équipe d'ingénierie dédiée (Tech Lead, Senior Software Engineers) et en étroite collaboration avec les UX Researchers, Product Designers, Data Analysts, Sports Digital Merchandisers ainsi que les équipes E-Commerce locales des différents pays.

  • Vision Produit : Favoriser la découverte grâce à une navigation intelligente et évolutive. Nous construisons un parcours de navigation intuitif, automatisé et personnalisé pour permettre à chaque client de trouver plus rapidement ce dont il a besoin et ce qu'il désire.
  • Objectif Cible : Stimuler la conversion globale et générer du chiffre d'affaires incrémental en transformant des arborescences locales fragmentées en une Core Navigation unifiée et performante sur le web et le mobile.

VOS MISSIONS

Vision & Stratégie Produit

  • Définir la vision produit, la stratégie et la roadmap pour l'écosystème Categories & Core Navigation.
  • Piloter et arbitrer les chantiers clés du produit : Core Navigation (standardisation des arborescences au niveau mondial) et les Moteurs de catégorisation au niveau SKU (comme notre moteur de streaming Tesseract).
  • Aligner les parties prenantes (équipes sports centrales, merchandising digital global, équipes pays) autour de modèles opérationnels partagés.

Discovery & Gouvernance

  • Identifier en continu les opportunités utilisateurs, SEO et business via l'analyse de données, des tests utilisateurs et des études de card-sorting.
  • Etablir un processus continue et consistant d'AB test permettant d’affiner les convictions business et identifier les meilleurs opportunité de croissance
  • Concilier la standardisation globale avec la flexibilité nécessaire aux marchés locaux, en assurant la migration fluide des arborescences locales vers les Core Trees globaux.
  • Établir des cadres de décision et des SLA clairs pour la taxonomie globale, la gouvernance SEO et la création de catégories.

Delivery & Alignement Technique

  • Piloter le delivery agile en partenariat étroit avec le Tech Lead et les développeurs de la squad.
  • Prioriser et affiner le backlog (epics, user stories) pour soutenir les flux d'exportation multi-niveaux, les outils d'orchestration de batchs et l'exécution des règles taxonomiques.
  • Superviser les jalons clés de migration pour les pays adoptant le framework Core Navigation sur desktop et mobile.

Data & Performance

  • Définir et suivre les métriques de succès de la navigation, notamment le PDP Reach Rate, le Revenu par Session, le CTR d'utilisation du Menu et la Conversion par Catégorie.
  • Exploiter l'analyse de données pour optimiser la performance des catégories, éliminer les catégories inactives et rationaliser les filtres taxonomiques.
  • Agencer et prioriser le backlog en s’appuyant sur de la data claire et fiable 

Culture & Mindset Produit

  • Incarner un rôle d'ambassadeur de l'excellence produit et des standards de taxonomie au sein du réseau international de Decathlon.
  • Favoriser un environnement de travail collaboratif fondé sur la confiance, la responsabilité et la centricité utilisateur.

PROFIL RECHERCHÉ

  • Expérience : 3 à 5+ ans d'expérience en tant que Product Manager dans un environnement B2C

Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About The Role We're looking for a Senior Product Manager with real technical depth and an  AI-first way of working . You'll own a product area end to end: finding problems worth solving, shaping the solution, taking it from 0 to 1 and growing it from there.
You understand architecture, you've written code, you know how databases work, and you speak engineering fluently. Your main job is product. The technical depth is what lets you move faster and make better calls.
AI isn't a feature we're adding. It's how we work and how we build. Expect roughly 70% product and 30% engineering, with full accountability for results.

 Your Mission Product direction: set the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area. Decide what to build, why, and how success is measured.
 0-to-1 delivery: take new products and features from problem discovery to launch and iteration.
 Discovery and validation: work directly with users and data to understand real problems, not assumed ones. Run interviews, usability tests and experiments before committing to build.
 Metrics and outcomes: define, instrument and track the KPIs for your area. Use product analytics to find friction, prioritise the highest-impact work, and shut down what doesn't work.
 Engineering partnership: understand architectural trade-offs, review technical approaches and unblock decisions. Write specs engineers actually want to read: clear, technical and opinionated.
 AI and automation: find where LLMs and agents create real product value, build the case, and ship it.
 Fast prototyping: validate ideas with AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, agents), scripts, no-code, or whatever gets you to the answer quickest.
 Hands-on work: write queries, dig into data pipelines, spin up prototypes, and open a PR when it makes sense.
 Prioritisation: balance user impact, business value, effort and regulatory constraints, and work closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics and business owners to ship continuously.
 

 Your Profile 5+ years in product management or product engineering with strong technical involvement, and a track record of taking products from 0 to live use with real users.
 AI-native: you use LLMs, vibe coding and agents daily, and you've applied LLMs or agentic AI to real products.
 Strong in Python or a similar language, enough to build things yourself. Comfortable with SQL, git, databases and evaluating system architecture.
 Fluent in product analytics and research: you define metrics, read data yourself, and validate through interviews, usability testing and experiments.
 Strong grasp of UX. You can take a complex flow and make it simple.
 Experience shipping with Design and Engineering in an agile environment.
 Clear communicator in English and self-directed. You can explain technical decisions to non-technical people, write specs engineers respect, and don't wait to be told what matters.
 
Nice to Have
 Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field.
 Experience in fintech or another regulated industry.
 Early-stage startup background.
 Hands-on LLM orchestration or prompt engineering.
 Background in software engineering, QA or product analytics.

jobs.title: Enterprise Product Manager - ElevenCreative
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs
 ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
 We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
 ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

 Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
 
 How we work
 High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

 
 What we offer
 Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

 About the role
 We're hiring an Enterprise PM to own the product experience for businesses using ElevenCreative. ElevenCreative helps creators and marketers generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. A growing share of that usage comes from enterprise teams, including brands, agencies, studios, and media companies that roll it out across their organizations.
 You'll own enterprise revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, and use every lever available to move them. That covers the admin, permissioning, and governance features large organizations need to deploy ElevenCreative across teams, as well as the enterprise products we're building on top of the platform, like our Ads Engine. You'll work directly with sales and customers to understand what's blocking deals and adoption, scope and define the big bets, and ship them.
 PMs at ElevenLabs work in small, highly collaborative teams with minimal process, alongside engineers who have room to build creatively and lead. The scope is broad by design. Some weeks lean toward product, others toward go-to-market or customer work, and you'll own whatever it takes to make ElevenCreative the best product for enterprise teams.
 
 What you'll do
 Own enterprise revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, pulling on product, pricing, packaging, go-to-market, and customer levers to drive results

 Scope and define the big bets for enterprise, from discovery through launch and adoption

 Build the admin and governance layer enterprises need, including role-based permissions, visibility into who has access to what, usage and spend controls, and reporting across teams

 Partner with engineering to scope and ship enterprise products like Ads Engine, turning complex customer workflows into products that scale beyond a single account

 Work with sales to triage feature requests and deal blockers, prioritize across them, and close the gap between what customers need and what we ship

 Join customer conversations to understand how enterprise teams evaluate, buy, and roll out creative tooling, and bring those insights back into the roadmap

 Define success metrics for enterprise features and track adoption, expansion, and retention across accounts

 Work closely with engineering, design, sales, and growth to ship quickly and drive projects all the way through

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Project Manager / Consultant (German required)
jobs.description:
Location: Hybrid, Zürich (2-3 days in office) 
 
 About what. AG 
 We're a Zurich-based digital consultancy with 40+ ambitious, kind specialists. We build websites, digital products and growth strategies powered by data and AI, for clients from innovative startups to global brands. Learn more at what.digital . 

 The role: You take a business-first, data-driven view of what's holding a client's growth back, use AI to diagnose it faster and deeper than a traditional audit, and turn it into a concrete plan that works. It's a long-term role with variety, autonomy, support and a clear path to grow. 

 How we work: You own your growth, and we give you the space to work on yourself. We deliver first-class help to our clients, from start to finish. We focus on real results, not just activity. And we think like entrepreneurs: when we build for clients, everyone wins - our clients, what. and you. 

 
 What you'll do: 
 Be the main point of contact for your clients and build long-term relationships - you think about their business, not just their campaigns. 

 Implement growth strategies across SEO/GEO, paid ads, email, social and more, using AI with the team. 

 Coordinate specialists to deliver great work on time and on budget, with high standards and honest feedback. 

 Run data and AI-assisted analyses to find growth opportunities and turn them into business cases and new projects. 

 Keep an eye on budgets and billing, with support from our finance team. 

 Optional: lead the specialist team, including team happiness and recruiting. 

 
 Key & Essential Skills: 
 Ideally 7+ years in a performance agency (not media buying), including 3+ years leading a team of 3+. 

 Deep knowledge of at least 3 marketing channels (e.g. SEO, Google Ads, Meta, content), with CHF 1M+ in total managed budget. 

 Proven record in client strategy, sales and building data-driven business cases that clients invest in. 

 Native-level German, understanding of Swiss German, fluent English. 

 Comfortable using AI as a core tool for analysis, reporting and consulting. 

 
 What makes you a fit: 
 You like taking ownership and seeing things through. 

 You give honest feedback, to clients and to us. 

 You know when to plan carefully, when to perfect, and when to move fast. 

 You think like an entrepreneur: curious, commercially minded, always moving forward. 

 
 Perks: 
 Beautiful office in Seefeld, Zurich. 

 You'll have real responsibility and influence - and a team that has your back. If you see something that could be improved, speak up - we're listening. 

 Flexible hours and a flat hierarchy - we're results-oriented and don't micromanage. 

 A multicultural team that learns together, including daily hands-on work with AI tools like Claude. 

 25 days holiday plus public holidays. 

 Fair compensation and profit participation. 

 Personal development opportunities, e.g. in 2026 we sent 10 people to Tony Robbins' UPW event. 

 
 How to Apply: 
 Apply via our website with your CV and a 2-3 min intro video in German (e.g. Loom or YouTube): tell us what attracted you to this role and share an example where you helped a client grow or improved something at work. 

 👉 Applications without a video or sent via other channels (e.g. email or social media) won't be considered.

 Running high-impact A/B tests requires coordination across many disciplinesâresearch, strategy, design, copywriting, development, QA, analytics, and client stakeholders. Your job is to keep everything moving forward, aligned, and energized.

 Key Responsibilities

 Coordination . Youâll manage cross-functional teams of 5â10 people and ensure tests move smoothly from idea â build â launch â analysis. Youâll spot risks early, unblock teams, and make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

 Strategy & Planning. Youâll help build and maintain a testing roadmap of 10â20 upcoming experiments. Youâll communicate the âwhyâ behind the plan, set expectations, and walk clients through progress and results in weekly meetings.

 Energy (âVibesâ). Youâre the main point of contact for clients and internal teams. You bring clarity, positivity, and momentum. When things get busy or complicated, you keep people focused and motivated.

 
 Skills, Knowledge and Traits

 You do not need prior A/B testing experience or even formal project management experience. We will train you. Hereâs what we need from you:

 
 Organization and diligence. You like systems, checklists, and timelines. You front-load work, plan ahead, and donât stop until things are finished properly.
