jobs.title: Staff Product Manager
jobs.description:
Unleash AI Innovators, Securely 
 Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it.
 Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate. It's a team of security agents working alongside your engineers, finding, fixing, and governing risk at the speed software is now built. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust.
 Why this role? 
  
 As a Staff Product Manager in Snyk's Agent Security division, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping how modern organizations build and secure AI applications at scale. You'll join a collaborative, forward-thinking team and help drive our mission to embed security into every part of the AI-native development lifecycle. This is a unique opportunity to shape early-stage products from the ground up, operating with the agility of a startup while leveraging the scale of an industry leader.
 
 What You’ll Do 
 Lead new product discovery from idea to execution by partnering with engineers, designers, and customers to identify high-potential opportunities in AI security and beyond.

 Validate problem-solution fit by designing lean experiments and MVPs to quickly validate customer problems and solution approaches.

 Shape the vision and roadmap for the capabilities that you own, balancing short-term experiments with long-term strategic bets.

 Influence the broader innovation agenda by presenting roadmap and strategy to customers, leadership, and internal stakeholders.

 Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to take new ideas from concept to product-market fit.

 
 What You Bring 
 You have solid experience in technology, with strong experience in a product management role.

 You bring a strong technical background and the ability to engage deeply with engineering and AI/ML concepts.

 You are comfortable with high ambiguity and can design frameworks to execute effectively in fast-moving, uncertain environments.

 You have a proven track record of taking early-stage products from concept to launch within SaaS or developer tooling.

 You have strong communication and storytelling skills to influence across teams, leadership, and customers.

 
 It’d Be Awesome If You Also… 
 Have hands-on experience in developer security, AI/ML products, or agentic systems.

 Contribute to open-source or developer communities.

 Have a background in software engineering or have worked in a startup or internal incubator environment.

 Love solving complex problems with a collaborative team.

 Bring fresh ideas and aren’t afraid to challenge the status quo.

 About Snyk 
 Snyk is committed to creating an inclusive and engaging environment where our employees can thrive as we rally behind our common mission to make the digital world a safer place. From Snyk employee resource groups, to global benefits that help our employees prioritize their health, wellness, financial security, and a work/life blend, we aim to support our employees along their entire journeys here at Snyk.
 
 Equal Employment Opportunity 
 Snyk is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

jobs.title: Product Manager Ultra Low Latency Networks
jobs.description:
The Role

 

This role has full ownership of euNetworks' market-leading Ultra-Low Latency (ULL) trading product. You will be accountable for the strategy, commercial performance, investment decisions and long-term growth of a network that serves some of the world's most sophisticated financial institutions.

You will operate as the business owner for euTrade, with direct responsibility for its P&L and the freedom to shape its future direction. Your decisions will dictate where we invest, which routes we build, how we compete and how we maintain our leadership position in one of the most demanding and competitive markets in telecommunications.

This is a role for someone who enjoys solving difficult problems, accountability, uncovering opportunities before competitors do and building defensible advantages. While an interest in networks and financial markets is helpful, we place far greater value on commercial judgement, intellectual curiosity, strategic thinking and execution.

If you've read Flash Boys by Michael Lewis, or you’ve watched The Hummingbird Project and found yourself fascinated by the commercial value of latency, the race to build faster routes and the strategic importance of infrastructure, this role offers the opportunity to shape and grow one of the industry's leading ultra-low-latency platforms.

 

What will you be doing?

Own the Business

  • Manage the project management and product P&L, including revenue growth, profitability and cost leadership
  • Build business cases and evaluate investment opportunities
  • Define pricing strategy and support sales drive return on investment.

Understand the Market Better Than Anyone Else

  • Develop a deep understanding of exchange growth, liquidity shifts, mergers, acquisitions and venue migrations
  • Understand trading firm and market data provider business models, points-of-presence, and the value of latency within their ecosystems
  • Analyse competitor strategies, strengths, network developments and customer loyalty dynamics
  • Identify opportunities to create unique and defensible competitive advantages.

Develop Winning Strategies

  • Apply game theory, competitive assessment and structured problem-solving to identify and develop unique, defendable route opportunities
  • Evaluate competitor behaviour, market dynamics and strategic trade-offs to determine the most effective investment and go-to-market decisions
  • Assess risks, scenarios and potential responses before committing resources, adapting strategies as market conditions evolve
  • Use data, market intelligence and commercial insight to guide decision-making and strengthen competitive advantage.

Lead the Product Lifecycle

  • Define product strategy and long-term roadmap
  • Manage lifecycle decisions across the portfolio
  • Support new logo acquisition, cross-sell and upsell campaigns.

Build Relationships Across the Ecosystem and combined with market Intelligent 

  • Develop strategic relationships with customers, partners and industry stakeholders
  • Influence decision-makers and build credibility across the market
  • Negotiate commercial agreements and partnership opportunities
  • Support Sales in customer engagements and product positioning.

 

What do we want from you?

Commercial Instinct

  • Strong commercial judgement and an ownership mindset
  • Experience evaluating opportunities, investments and business cases
  • Ability to balance growth, profitability and strategic positioning
  • Comfortable making decisions with incomplete information

Exceptional Problem Solving Ability

  • A structured and analytical approach to complex challenges
  • Outstanding attention to detail especially during planning
  • Ability to assess options, risks and competitive responses
  • Natural curiosity and a desire to understand how markets really work
  • Interest in strategy, incentives, game theory and competitive dynamics

Shrewd Tactical Thinking

  • You enjoy competition and finding ways to win
  • You anticipate competitor actions and position accordingly
  • You understand how small advantages can compound into meaningful market leadership
  • You are constantly looking for opportunities to create sustainable differentiation

Self-Motivation and Drive

  • A go-getter mentality with a bias towards execution
  • Comfortable working auto

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
Your mission CALM’s digital products play an important role in helping people find support when they need it. Your job is to make that experience even better.

You’ll be at the heart of a collaborative team, leading the development and continuous improvement of the CALMzone app. You’ll turn user insight, data and ideas into intuitive, accessible experiences. You’ll work across product, design, research, data and technology, with plenty of scope to shape the app and contribute to CALM’s wider digital ecosystem.

 Please note:   This role strictly requires proven experience in mobile app product management (launching and/or running an app on iOS/Android). Applications with solely web, digital marketing or CRM experience will not be considered.

 Your profile Responsibilities 
 Product Strategy & Delivery Deliver the mobile product strategy, as defined by the Senior Product Manager.
 Manage the app through all stages of the lifecycle: discovery through to optimisation and iteration.
 Own the continuous improvement of the app, including accessibility, onboarding and bootflow.
 Manage the app’s technical health and stability across a range of devices.
 Create, maintain, and prioritise product backlogs, ensuring alignment with organisation goals and user needs.
 Define user stories with acceptance criteria and guide development teams through delivery.
 
 Mobile Experience & Insight Act as a UX lead mapping and optimising mobile user journeys, ensuring they are intuitive, inclusive, and insight-led.
 Working with the Insight and Analytics team generate user insights through research, usability testing, and data analysis, and translate findings into actionable improvements.
 Champion user-centred design and accessibility best practices.
 Collaborate with mobile researchers, UI/UX designers, app developers, and agencies to ensure excellent delivery.
 
 Stakeholder Engagement & Communication Engage with stakeholders at all levels to gather requirements, align priorities, and report progress.
 Act as a translator between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 Promote a data-driven, test-and-learn culture across teams.
 Ensure that the CALMzone app is strategically aligned.
 Continuous Improvement
 Monitor and analyse app performance using data, analytics, and feedback loops.
 Drive a culture of continuous optimisation and regular update cadence.
 Keep up-to-date with product management best practices, trends, OS and app store trends, bringing innovations into the CALMzone app.
 
 Your profile 
 Competencies Mobile app lifecycle management
 Product strategy
 Agile execution and delivery
 Data-driven decision making
 Stakeholder management
 Cross-functional collaboration - working with both technical and non-technical teams
 
 Experience Hands-on Mobile app experience: 2+ years of experience as a Product Manager launching and/or running a mobile app. Junior or associate Product Managers will be considered.

Description We are seeking a product manager to own the "what" and "why" of our quantum sensing measurement systems. You turn customer and market needs into clear product requirements that engineering can turn into specifications, and you own the roadmap for the QDm product line, starting with QDm.1. You sit between our customers (foundries, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs) and every engineering discipline, and you make sure we build the right product in the right order. 

 Who we are Founded in 2022 as a spin-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three-dimensional current maps within multi-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale - and shaping the next chapter in chip testing.

 Why join us? Picture this: 
 Quantum sensors that see inside the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide.
 Nobel-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday.
 Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on.
 An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you.
 Still unsure about why joining us? 
 You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before.
 From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds.
 Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years.
 You’ll be part of a high-growth company backed by top-tier investors.
 Let’s make the invisible visible! 

 What will you do Own the product requirements: gather needs from customers, the field, the market, and internal stakeholders (serviceability, modularity and product configuration, manufacturability, and cost targets), and turn them into clear, prioritized, solution-neutral requirements.
 Establish our requirements engineering tooling and workflow: select and set up how we capture, trace, and maintain requirements, from customer need through specification to verification, including change control across releases. This is a foundational task in your first months.
 Own and maintain the QDm.1 roadmap: propose what gets built and in what order, make the trade-offs explicit, and align decisions with the management team.
 Work with the applications team on customer interactions and evaluations with fabs, IDMs, OSATs and failure analysis labs, and translate what you learn into requirements.

 What is expected of you Several years in product management for complex hardware or capital equipment, ideally in semiconductor, metrology, or a comparable deep-tech environment.
 A track record of writing clear product requirements that engineering can actually build from.
 The ability to talk to both customers and engineers and to translate between them.
 Enough technical depth to hold a credible conversation with the people designing the product, across mechanics, optics, electronics/RF, and software.
 Structured prioritization: you make trade-offs explicit and back them with reasoning.
 We hire for demonstrated skill rather than a specific degree; a technical or scientific background is typical. The working language is English.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Hardware & Edge AI (d/f/m)
jobs.description:
New Challenge About Us 
Project Q GmbH ("Q") is a defence technology company with offices in Berlin and Munich, and a trusted partner of the German Armed Forces. Our customers field sensors, drones and C2 systems from many vendors that were never built to work together. We build Hydris, an orchestration layer that integrates the systems they already field, and the ones they'll add next, into one picture operators can act on across defence, public safety, and critical infrastructure. Hydris runs at the edge, keeps working when the link drops, and its core is open source under Apache 2.0.

As Senior Product Manager for Mission Devices, you'll own the hardware that puts Hydris in the field. 

You'll work end-to-end, from discovery with operators through hardware build cycles to fielded units, and you'll decide what gets built rather than work through someone else's backlog. The bar is concrete: devices that run for months off-grid in contested RF environments.

What you'll do
 Discovery and requirements Spend time with end users in their operating environment to understand their workflows in depth, not just their stated requirements.
 Validate assumptions about value, usability, feasibility and viability through prototypes, bench tests and field trials before committing to hardware fabrication.
 Analyze contractual specifications with Program Managers, separating firm constraints from areas where there's room for the best technical solution.
 Roadmap and delivery Maintain an outcome-focused roadmap aligned to hardware build cycles (EVT/DVT/PVT), firmware releases and OTA update pipelines.
 Define requirements and field metrics for each device, including detection performance, energy efficiency, mission endurance and SWaP, and make the trade-offs between them.
 Prioritize investment across the device family, deciding where to extend existing devices and where a new one is needed.
 Systems and interoperability Make sure devices integrate with Hydris as and interoperate with third-party systems through industry standards and protocols.
 Design provisioning, commissioning and deployment workflows that are simple and reliable in the field.
 Investigate issues that span hardware, firmware and communications, and work with engineering to resolve them.
 Collaboration Act as the main source of product context and the product's champion, making sure the team, leadership and customers understand what we're building and why.
 Work in a product trio with engineering (hardware and ML) and design. 
 Partner with Program and Capture Managers to keep the product vision aligned with contractual commitments.
 Write clear PRDs and decision records, and mentor teammates on discovery practice and hardware–software trade-offs.
 
You should apply if you have
 5+ years of product management experience with hardware–software products, for example in embedded systems, IoT, robotics, defence systems or edge AI.
 Experience taking a connected hardware product from EVT/DVT through production into operational use, including in-field updates.
 Experience running product development end to end, from discovery to engineering-ready work, and the ability to adapt to however a team works.
 Ability making decisions with incomplete information, and the judgment to know when a decision is risky enough to slow down.
 Clear communication with hardware engineers, ML researchers and operators alike.
 Motivation to contribute to European security and sovereignty.
 Willingness to travel regularly to military exercises, test ranges and customer sites in Germany and NATO partner countries, sometimes in demanding field conditions.
 Eligibility for German security clearance (SÜ2).
 Fluency in German and English (C1 or higher).
 You'd be a particularly great fit with 
 A degree in electrical, mechanical or systems engineering, robotics or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience bringing hardware products from prototype to production.
 Experience in military, public safety or other mission-critical operational environments.
 Exposure to sensor fusion, mesh networking or degraded RF environments, including familiarity with interoperability standards such as Cursor on Target, SAPIENT, ONVIF or ASTERIX.
 
We Offer Direct feedback from the field: you'll see the products you build tested in real operating environments by the people who use them.
 Prime Berlin-Mitte location – right between Alexanderplatz and Hackescher Markt.
 High degree of autonomy and ownership, and flat structure.
 Annual €1500 Learning & development budget  (available after probation).
 Bike Leasing and Urban Sports Club membership.
 30 days of paid time off.
 
 Note: We're unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role – candidates must already be eligible to work in Germany.

Wir suchen dich als Senior Project Manager für unseren großen Kunden aus dem Automobilbereich am Standort Hamburg. Da du intern wie extern die kommunikativen Fäden in der Hand hältst und direkt mit dem Kunden am Tisch sitzt, sind fließende Deutschkenntnisse für diese Rolle deine absolute Basis. Dein Fokus liegt zu einhundert Prozent auf der Betreuung, Pflege und redaktionellen Weiterentwicklung komplexer digitaler Webplattformen. Du verantwortest den langfristigen und nachhaltigen Betrieb unserer digitalen Produkte. Als Senior bist du das strategische und organisatorische Rückgrat für unsere Content Teams sowie UX Designer und stellst sicher, dass neue Inhalte strukturiert, geprüft und pünktlich live gehen.

 Deine Aufgaben 
Du übernimmst die operative Steuerung und die strategische Planung von großen digitalen Pflegeprojekten sowie weltweiten Content Rollouts. Dabei agierst du als zentrale und souveräne Schnittstelle zwischen dem Kunden, der Kreation und den redaktionellen Teams.
Dein Arbeitsalltag ist geprägt von agilen Methoden. Du übersetzt komplexe inhaltliche Anforderungen in klare Aufgabenpakete, führst das Backlog und koordinierst die Sprints sicher über Jira. Für eine saubere Dokumentation und den transparenten Wissenstransfer nutzt du Confluence.
Du hast ein tiefes Verständnis für Content Management Systeme und steuerst die kontinuierliche Pflege sowie redaktionelle Befüllung der Plattform. Qualität ist für dich kein Zufall. Du planst umfassende Abnahmen für Texteingaben und Bildmaterial und gibst keine neuen Seiten live, die nicht unseren hohen Standards entsprechen.
Du behältst Timings, Ressourcen und Budgets für die kontinuierliche Betreuung der Plattform stets im Blick. Als Senior bewahrst du auch in stressigen Phasen einen kühlen Kopf und leitest dein Projektteam sicher durch komplexe Publikationsprozesse.

 Dein Profil Erfahrung: Du hast langjährige Erfahrung im digitalen Projektmanagement gesammelt und dabei große Webplattformen oder redaktionelle Rollouts hauptverantwortlich gesteuert.
 Plattform Wissen: Du kennst dich hervorragend mit modernen Content Management Systemen aus und verstehst die Prozesse hinter erfolgreicher digitaler Redaktion und Plattformpflege.
 Agilität: Du bist ein absoluter Profi im Umgang mit agilen Arbeitsweisen und steuerst Workflows routiniert über Jira und Confluence.
 Leadership: Du sprichst die Sprache der Content Creator genau so fließend wie die der Kunden. Du trittst absolut sicher auf und führst dein Projektteam mit klarer Orientierung.
 Arbeitsweise: Du arbeitest extrem strukturiert, bringst eine hohe Lösungsorientierung mit und bewahrst bei umfassenden Content Rollouts stets die Ruhe.
 Sprache: Neben deinen fließenden Deutschkenntnissen kommunizierst du auch auf Englisch absolut sicher und verbindlich.
 

 Warum wir? Bei uns erwartet dich ein attraktiver Arbeitsplatz im Herzen von St. Pauli verbunden mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten
 Du triffst auf eine offene Agenturkultur, die von Kreativität und Menschlichkeit geleitet ist
 Der respektvolle Umgang miteinander auf Augenhöhe ist bei uns Prinzip
 Bei uns hast du Eigenverantwortung und wirst zu selbstständigem Arbeiten motiviert
 Du wirst inhaltlich geführt und hast Raum für deine berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung
 Du profitierst von unserer globalen DDB-Trainingsplattform mit umfangreichen Fachthemen und Skill-Trainings (u.a. LinkedIn Learning und Babbel)
 Förderung deiner Mobilität (Bezuschussung des Deutschlandtickets sowie Kooperation mit Jobrad) 
 Mit Angeboten, wie einer Kooperation mit dem PME-Familienservice sowie Wellhub, wollen wir deine Gesundheit unterstützen
 Leckeres Frühstück mit frischem Brot an deinen Bürotagen
 Du hast die Möglichkeit, regelmäßig von zu Hause zu arbeiten 
 

 Unser Standort Wir sind in St.Pauli, im Zirkusweg zwischen Reeperbahn und Elbe. Zwischen schreienden Möwen und gemeinsamen Abenden in den berüchtigtsten und liebenswertesten Kneipen auf dem Kiez. Immer im Austausch, gerne auch im 19. Stock. Dann reden wir darüber, was wir noch nicht gesehen haben. Was wir vorhaben und wie wir das zusammen schaffen. Mit viel Vertrauen zueinander und noch mehr Leidenschaft. Wir lieben es Marken digital zu begleiten, zu führen und erfolgreiche Lösungen zu entwickeln. Für Kunden wie zum Beispiel Volkswagen, Lufthansa und IKEA Austria.  Wir freuen uns auf jeden Menschen. Und auf alle Bewerbungen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion und Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Licensing & Billing)
jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. 
 n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.
 
 Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:
 
 Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation

 
That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register .
 
 We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.
 
 Your main goal will be to make it simple and reliable for customers to buy, pay for, and grow their use of n8n. You'll own the foundations of how n8n's commercial system works: licensing and entitlements, customer accounts, and the metering and billing platform for both Cloud and Enterprise. Today these live across several teams and two billing stacks; you'll bring them into one stable home that the rest of the company builds on.
 
 This is a foundations role. You build the system that pricing and packaging decisions run on, rather than running price experiments yourself. To do so, here are your core responsibilities:
 
 OWN THE LICENSING & BILLING STRATEGY & ROADMAP
 Define and communicate the product strategy and roadmap for Licensing & Billing in partnership with Engineering, Product leadership, Finance, and go-to-market.

 Prioritize foundational investments based on revenue integrity, enterprise needs, data correctness, and engineering effort, and make trade-offs explicit.

 Lead discovery with enterprise customers, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and RevOps to understand how n8n is bought, renewed, and grown today, and where that breaks.

 
 LICENSING, ENTITLEMENTS & ACCOUNTS
 Own the license server and entitlement model: issuance, renewal, and validation across Cloud, self-hosted, air-gapped, and OEM deployments, with one source of truth for which plan or deal grants which features.

 Introduce "account" as a first-class product primitive (accounts, purchases, license keys, activations) and expose it as the API contract our customer-facing console and multi-instance management are built on.

 Productize the deal-to-entitlement flow so a closed deal in Salesforce creates or updates entitlements without manual steps.

 
 METERING & BILLING PLATFORM
 Own usage metering and billing for Cloud and Enterprise, including subscription billing: what counts as a billable execution, quota consumption, and overage charging.

 Lead the migration off Paddle Classic and unify Cloud and Enterprise billing into one platform.

 Build the mechanics for usage-based enterprise billing and reliable overage charging.

 
 CROSS-ORG ALIGNMENT
 Make the architecture and mechanism decisions (entitlement model, billing platform, enterprise invoicing path) and align closely with Finance and go-to-market on each of them. Every decision here touches money; you bring people along rather than inform them afterwards.

 Hold clear boundaries with adjacent teams: the customer console, execution limits, and access control live elsewhere; you own the data and mechanics they rely on.

 Establish clear success measures and keep the squad accountable for outcomes, not only delivery.

 
 REQUIREMENTS
 
 Must-haves
 Billing or licensing product experience: You have 6+ years in Product, with a substantial part spent owning a billing, licensing, entitlement, or quote-to-cash system at a B2B SaaS company.

 Shipped through Finance and RevOps: You've driven a cross-functional systems change where Finance, Sales Ops, and Engineering all had a say, and you got it live.

 Systems and data-model depth: You can design or critique an entity model, reason about reconciliation and idempotency in a sync, read an API contract, and explain why two systems reading the same events end up with different numbers.

 Attention to detail: You know that if the billing data is wrong, everything built on it inherits the error, and you sequence work accordingly.

 Prioritization under ambiguity: You make trade-offs explicit and connect foundational or data-quality work to commercial outcomes.

 Ownership and autonomy: You grab problems without being asked, fix what you see broken, and drive outcomes without waiting

jobs.title: Product Marketing Lead
jobs.description:
🚀 About Nivoda 
 Nivoda is a fast-growing B2B marketplace that is transforming the global diamond and gemstone industry. We connect buyers and sellers across the world, processing $300M+ in annual transactions and unlocking a $350B industry opportunity. We move fast, think big, and care deeply about the businesses and people we serve.
  
 🌍 Our Mission 
 The diamond trading industry has historically been fragmented, opaque, and inaccessible. Nivoda was founded to change that: to empower businesses of all sizes and locations to participate in a fair, efficient global marketplace. Every line of code, every integration, every automation we build brings us closer to that mission.
  
  
 About the Role 
 We are looking for a Product Marketing Lead to own how Nivoda explains itself: the positioning, the messaging, and the story that makes independent jewellers understand why we are worth switching to. This is the foundation the rest of marketing is built on, from paid campaigns to sales conversations. You will define who we are for, what we say, and why it lands, and then arm the whole go-to-market team to say it consistently.
 This is a hands-on role. You will own positioning and messaging, lead the go-to-market for new product launches, sharpen our competitive edge, and build the sales enablement that turns interest into customers.
 You will start as a senior individual contributor with real ownership of product marketing end to end. As the company grows there is room to build a function beneath you, but this is a role for a builder who wants to do the work, not just direct it.
  
 What would you be doing? 
 Own Nivoda’s positioning and messaging: define who we are for, the problems we solve, and the words we use, and keep them sharp as the business evolves.

 Lead the go-to-market for product launches. Shape the narrative, coordinate across teams, and make sure new features land with the jewellers they are built for.

 Build the competitive intelligence that keeps us ahead: understand the alternatives jewellers weigh, and give the team the arguments that win.

 Arm our sales team with the enablement they need, from one-pagers and decks to talk tracks, so every conversation tells a consistent and compelling story.

 Own the messaging and narrative on our core product and positioning pages, partnering with the teams who own the website and the signup experience.

 Shape our pricing and packaging story so the value is obvious and easy to say yes to.

 Feed clear, tested messaging into demand gen and content, so campaigns ladder up to one coherent point of view without ever feeling like an ad.

 Ground everything in customer truth: talk to jewellers, run win/loss, and turn what you learn into sharper positioning.

 Partner closely with product and the growth PM so what we build and how we talk about it stay in lockstep.

  
 What do we need from you? 
 5+ years in product marketing, ideally at a B2B or marketplace company, with a track record of positioning and launches that moved the business.

 You are a builder. You would rather write the messaging, run the launch, and ship the deck than hand it off.

 Exceptional writing and storytelling. You can take something complex and make it simple, sharp, and persuasive.

 A strategic head for positioning: you can define a market, a segment, and a wedge, and defend your choices.

 Comfort with data and customer research. You start from evidence, not opinion.

 You work well across functions, especially with sales and product, and you build trust quickly.

 Comfort as a senior IC on a small team, building process where none exists, with the ambition to grow a function over time.

 You are AI forward, always testing new tools, and learnings new applications of AI to improve your efficiency and effectiveness

  
 Nice to have 
 Experience marketing to small business owners, retailers, or a trade audience.

 A marketplace, self-serve, or product-led growth background.

 Sales enablement experience for an SDR or inside-sales motion.

 Experience running competitive intelligence or win/loss programs.

 A real interest in jewellery, retail, or craft, or the curiosity to fall for the space quickly.

 
 Our culture and what we offer 
 We're a high-growth company in an exponential expansion phase. We move fast, operate with low hierarchy, and give people real ownership from day one. If you want to work somewhere you can genuinely shape things: not just maintain them: Nivoda is the place.
  
 Our current benefits 
 🕐 Flexible working hours and vibrant company culture

 🏡 Remote work

 🌴 Unlimited holiday allowance

 🚀 Chance to join during our exponential expansion phase

jobs.title: Product Lead
jobs.description:
Build the product engine behind the next generation of MedTech software. 
 REMATIQ is building AI software that helps life sciences and medical device companies bring products to market faster, without compromising the quality, traceability and compliance their industry demands.
 We work with leading companies including Philips, Siemens Healthineers, B. Braun and Novartis, and have recently closed our Series A.
 We believe in the value of in-person collaboration and work in a hybrid setup, with the team coming together in our office in the heart of Berlin-Mitte typically four days per week .
 Now we’re looking for a hands-on Product Lead / Head of Product to help us turn ambitious product direction into exceptional shipped product.
 
 The role
 This is a player-coach role for someone who wants real product ownership without moving away from the product itself.
 Our founder will continue to lead long-term product strategy, major capability bets and the frontier of where REMATIQ should go.
 You will own how we get there. 
 You’ll take responsibility for the full product execution loop:
 Customer insight → product ideas → prioritization → definition → engineering refinement → sprint execution → shipped product → learning. 
 You’ll lead a growing team of 2–3 Product Managers , raise the quality bar across the product organization, and still directly own one or two of our most important and complex product areas yourself.
 You won’t be managing the process from the sidelines. You’ll be in the details with customers, PMs, engineers and designers, making decisions and helping the team ship.
 
 What you’ll do
 Own product execution end to end: Turn strategic direction and customer insight into clear priorities, well-defined product work and shipped outcomes.

 Lead and develop the Product team: Manage 2–3 PMs, help them sharpen their judgment and execution, and establish a consistently high bar for product work.

 Stay hands-on: Personally lead discovery, define product requirements, make prioritization decisions and own some of our hardest product areas.

 Run product across multiple squads: Create clarity across Product, Engineering and Design and ensure teams move from idea to execution without unnecessary process or ambiguity.

 Make the hard calls: Navigate competing customer needs, technical constraints and incomplete information, and make clear product decisions rather than simply facilitating consensus.

 Build an AI-native product organization: Use AI deeply in your own work and help rethink how discovery, specification, prototyping, analysis and product development should work in an AI-first company.

 Stay close to customers: Understand how sophisticated enterprise teams actually work, identify the problems worth solving and turn customer insight into scalable product rather than one-off features.

 Continuously improve how we build: Identify where our product process needs more structure, where it needs less, and build the operating rhythm that helps REMATIQ ship better and faster as we scale.

 
 What we’re looking for
 You may be a strong fit if you:
 Have led product for a B2B enterprise software product .

 Have directly managed at least 2 Product Managers .

 Are still deeply hands-on and comfortable running discovery, writing and refining product requirements, prioritizing trade-offs and working closely with Engineering.

 Have owned product delivery across multiple squads or product areas .

 Have strong product judgment and are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information.

 Are genuinely AI-forward : you actively use AI in your work, understand how it changes product development, and have thoughtful views on what makes a product truly AI-native.

 Communicate exceptionally well, both in writing and in conversation.

 Operate with high ownership, pace and reliability.

 
 We’ll be especially excited if you
 Have been a founder, founding PM or very early product leader and can demonstrate founder-like ownership.

 Are technically strong enough to work deeply with engineers on APIs, data, AI systems, workflows and technical trade-offs .

 Learned product craft inside an excellent product organization with a high bar for execution.

 Have experienced both sides of the journey: building product in an early-stage environment and later helping a product organization scale.

 
 Why REMATIQ?
 A rare product moment: We have enterprise customers, strong demand and fresh Series A funding, while many of the product systems and ways of working for our next stage are still yours to shape.

 Real product ownership: You’ll have genuine authority over prioritization, product definition and execution, while staying close enough to the work to personally influence what gets built.

 Player-coach by design: This isn’t a role where leadership means leaving product craft behind. You’ll build the team while continuing to own meaningful product problems yourself.

 AI is the product and the way we work: You

jobs.title: Enterprise Product Manager - ElevenCreative
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs
 ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
 We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
 ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

 Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
 
 How we work
 High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

 
 What we offer
 Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

 About the role
 We're hiring an Enterprise PM to own the product experience for businesses using ElevenCreative. ElevenCreative helps creators and marketers generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. A growing share of that usage comes from enterprise teams, including brands, agencies, studios, and media companies that roll it out across their organizations.
 You'll own enterprise revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, and use every lever available to move them. That covers the admin, permissioning, and governance features large organizations need to deploy ElevenCreative across teams, as well as the enterprise products we're building on top of the platform, like our Ads Engine. You'll work directly with sales and customers to understand what's blocking deals and adoption, scope and define the big bets, and ship them.
 PMs at ElevenLabs work in small, highly collaborative teams with minimal process, alongside engineers who have room to build creatively and lead. The scope is broad by design. Some weeks lean toward product, others toward go-to-market or customer work, and you'll own whatever it takes to make ElevenCreative the best product for enterprise teams.
 
 What you'll do
 Own enterprise revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, pulling on product, pricing, packaging, go-to-market, and customer levers to drive results

 Scope and define the big bets for enterprise, from discovery through launch and adoption

 Build the admin and governance layer enterprises need, including role-based permissions, visibility into who has access to what, usage and spend controls, and reporting across teams

 Partner with engineering to scope and ship enterprise products like Ads Engine, turning complex customer workflows into products that scale beyond a single account

 Work with sales to triage feature requests and deal blockers, prioritize across them, and close the gap between what customers need and what we ship

 Join customer conversations to understand how enterprise teams evaluate, buy, and roll out creative tooling, and bring those insights back into the roadmap

 Define success metrics for enterprise features and track adoption, expansion, and retention across accounts

 Work closely with engineering, design, sales, and growth to ship quickly and drive projects all the way through

jobs.title: Self-Serve Product Manager - ElevenCreative
jobs.description:
About ElevenLabs
 ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.
 We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:
 ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

 Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.
 
 How we work
 High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

 
 What we offer
 Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

 About the role
 We're hiring a Self-Serve PM to own the core ElevenCreative product experience for creators and marketers who sign up, subscribe, and build on their own. Self-serve users make up the majority of ElevenCreative's user base, and they use the platform to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.
 You'll own self-serve revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, and use every lever available to move them. That includes how users discover what ElevenCreative can do, how they move from a first generation into agents, video, and multi-step creative workflows, and what keeps them coming back and upgrading. There's no shortage of things we could build. The job is defining the big bets, scoping them well, and shipping them quickly with the team.
 PMs at ElevenLabs work in small, highly collaborative teams with minimal process, alongside engineers who have room to build creatively and lead. The scope is broad by design. Some weeks lean toward product, others toward growth or go-to-market work, and you'll own whatever it takes to make ElevenCreative the best product for its users.
 
 What you'll do
 Own self-serve revenue, growth, and adoption for ElevenCreative, pulling on product, pricing, onboarding, lifecycle, and go-to-market levers to drive results

 Scope and define the big bets for the self-serve product across image, video, music, agents, and editing workflows

 Find the biggest opportunities in the user journey through product data and user behavior, and turn them into clearly scoped projects

 Drive adoption of newer experiences like agents and video, helping users expand from a single product into the full platform

 Work with engineering and design to ship quickly, mocking up early concepts yourself when it speeds things up

 Partner with growth, lifecycle, and social teams on launches and the moments that bring users into new parts of the product

 Define success metrics for your area and track activation, engagement, retention, and conversion to paid plans

 Talk to creators and marketers regularly to understand how they work and where the product falls short, and bring those insights back to the team

 
 Requirements
 5+ years of product management experience on consumer or self-serve products

 A track record of owning revenue, growth, or adoption outcomes and driving the

jobs.title: Head of Product Marketing (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
We're building a new global Berlitz, and this is your opportunity to help shape it. Nearly 150 years of expertise, meeting the ambition and technology to power a new era of learning. 

If you are the kind of person who thrives in a fast-paced environment, isn’t afraid of a blank page, and is excited to help shape the future of a global company undergoing a significant transformation, you might belong at Berlitz! 
 Berlitz is transforming how the world learns languages, moving from a legacy education brand into a modern, digital-first B2B platform. As we roll out the Berlitz App, Compass, and a new credit-based commercial model, we need a Head of Product Marketing to turn that transformation into a story buyers actually believe, and a go-to-market engine that delivers it. Reporting to the CPTO, you'll own positioning, messaging, and enablement for the business, and be the direct link between market reality and our product roadmap.
 Your responsibilities 
 Own and evolve segment positioning and messaging (HR, L&D, enterprise vs. SMB) as our product and commercial model transforms, keeping it consistent across every buyer touchpoint.

 Define the narrative architecture for new products and packaging, including the credit-based commercial model, Berlitz App, and Compass, in partnership with the CPTO and Product leadership.

 Lead GTM strategy and execution end-to-end for major product and feature launches, directing cross-functional coordination across marketing, sales, and product.

 Build, manage, and develop the product marketing team, setting standards for output quality and prioritisation.

 Own the sales enablement library, battlecards, decks, case studies, built globally and localised for major regions.

 Direct market and competitive research and convert findings into product implications, USPs, and pricing input.

 Own win/loss analysis as a standing discipline, feeding structured insight into positioning and product planning.

 Partner with Brand & Activation, ABM, Paid Performance, and Product leadership, and represent product marketing in CPTO-level planning forums.

 Who you are 
 You have 10+ years in product marketing, including 3+ years leading or managing a team.

 You've built and scaled a product marketing function, including sales enablement infrastructure and cross-functional launches at company-wide scale.

 You write and message at an executive level, translating technical and commercial complexity into buyer value.

 You're comfortable operating at leadership level across segments and geographies in a global, matrixed organisation, partnering directly with C-suite stakeholders.

 You're analytical and fluent in using competitive, win/loss, and customer data to inform and defend strategic decisions.

 You stand out if... 
 You've worked in HR tech, L&D, language learning, or education.

 You've operated through a major commercial or platform transformation, such as a system migration, pricing model change, or entity restructuring.

 You have deep familiarity with ABM and demand generation motions and how product marketing shapes them.

 You've worked in a global-local model spanning multiple regions, such as DE/EU and North America.

 Why you should join 
 Set the positioning and GTM strategy for Berlitz's next-generation B2B, digital-first offering.

 Partner directly with the CPTO on product and commercial transformation.

 Build and lead a product marketing team and enablement function from the ground up.

 Join a collaborative international team shaping how the world learns.

 Remote work but occasional travel may be required for business engagements or events.

 At Berlitz, connecting people across languages and cultures is at the heart of what we do. Our global workplace reflects the diverse world we serve, bringing together different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. We create an inclusive environment where everyone has an equal opportunity to belong, contribute and grow. 

Ready to shape what’s next? Join us and help build the future with us.

jobs.description:
The Position

Our roster has an opening with your name on it

As a Lead Product Designer at FanDuel, you are a trusted design leader responsible for raising design quality and driving meaningful customer impact across multiple teams or product areas. 

You combine exceptional craft, strategic thinking, systems design, customer insight, and cross-functional leadership to solve complex customer and business problems. While remaining hands-on, your impact extends to elevating the work of others - you improve ways of working, influence product direction, strengthen design systems and practices, and help teams consistently deliver exceptional customer experiences. 

You are expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, navigate ambiguity confidently, build alignment across disciplines, and consistently elevate the quality of both products and the design organization. 

 

THE GAME PLAN 
Everyone on our team has a part to play 

  • Lead large, ambiguous product initiatives spanning multiple teams, customer journeys, and business priorities. 
  • Connect design decisions directly to measurable customer and business outcomes.  
  • Build trusted partnerships with Product, Engineering, Insights, and leadership to inform product direction and strategic decisions. 
  • Balance customer needs, business priorities, technical constraints, compliance, and delivery considerations.  
  • Guide product decisions through evidence-based design, leveraging research, analytics, and experimentation insight.

jobs.title: Head of Product (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über DrAnsay 
 DrAnsay wurde 2018 gegründet und gehört heute zu den führenden digitalen Gesundheitsplattformen in Deutschland. Als digitales HealthTech-Unternehmen verbinden wir Patient:innen, Ärzt:innen und Apotheken und entwickeln technologische Lösungen, die Gesundheitsversorgung einfacher, schneller und zugänglicher machen. Mehr als 1 Million Patient:innen nutzen unsere Plattform bereits. Unser Anspruch ist klar: digitale Medizin so zu gestalten, dass sie im Alltag wirklich funktioniert.
 Wir arbeiten schnell, direkt und mit viel Eigenverantwortung. Wer zu uns kommt, übernimmt nicht einfach nur eine bestehende Rolle, sondern gestaltet Strukturen, Prozesse und Entscheidungen aktiv mit.
 
 Warum es diese Rolle gibt 
 DrAnsay befindet sich in einer Scale-up-Phase: Die Grundstrukturen der Produktorganisation stehen. Der Fokus liegt jetzt auf Optimierung, Effizienz und der Weiterentwicklung bestehender sowie neuer Produktinitiativen. Unser CPO verantwortet gleichzeitig kommerzielle und strategische Themen der Unternehmensführung. Neue Initiativen brauchen deshalb eine Person, die produktübergreifend Struktur schafft und den Takt hält.
 Die Position wird neu geschaffen, um diese Lücke zu schließen. Das ist keine Rolle, in der du Grundlagen aufräumst. Es geht darum, dass wir neue Produkte schneller starten und bei bestehenden Produkten an den richtigen Dingen arbeiten.
 
 Deine Rolle 
 Als Head of Product übernimmst du die Koordination produktübergreifender Roadmaps und OKR-Zyklen, verantwortest das unternehmensweite Produkt-Reporting und sorgst dafür, dass Metriken, Feature-Impact und Produktstrategie intern klar kommuniziert werden. Du berichtest direkt an unseren CPO und bist Schnittstelle zu einem neunköpfigen Produktteam aus Senior Product Managern und einem UX-Team sowie zu Data, Marketing und Engineering.
 
 Dein Ziel in den ersten Monaten ist es, alle Produktbereiche, unseren Markt und das Team gründlich zu verstehen. Du erkennst, wo Planung, Zusammenarbeit und Dokumentation besser werden können, machst einen Plan und setzt ihn um.
 
 Was du konkret machst 
 Produktübergreifende Roadmaps über mehrere Produktlinien und Teams hinweg koordinieren, aktuell halten und Abhängigkeiten zwischen Teams früh erkennen und auflösen

 OKRs und Key Results auf Team-Ebene mit der übergeordneten Produktstrategie verknüpfen und die Zyklen von der Planung bis zur Auswertung begleiten

 Die Produkt-Metriken und das unternehmensweite Reporting zum Feature-Impact verantworten, gemeinsam mit unserem Data-Team

 Vorhaben hinterfragen, die zu wenig Kunden- oder Geschäftswert schaffen, und Alternativen vorschlagen

 User Research strukturiert in laufende Produktentwicklung einbinden, gemeinsam mit unserem Head of UX und dem UX-Team

 Die Arbeitsweise unserer Product Manager weiterentwickeln, besonders Planung, Dokumentation und Reporting

 Product Discovery und die frühe Teamstrukturierung neuer Produktinitiativen unterstützen, inklusive Abstimmung mit Engineering

 Die unternehmensweite Kommunikation zur Produktstrategie aufbauen und Produktentscheidungen für alle nachvollziehbar dokumentieren

 
 Das brauchst du 
 Erfahrung in einer Product-Leadership-Rolle, etwa als Head of Product, Product Lead oder Group Product Manager. Du hast über dein eigenes Produkt hinaus Verantwortung getragen, für mehrere Product Manager, Teams oder Produktbereiche, fachlich oder disziplinarisch

 Erfahrung mit digitalen Produkten für Endkund:innen (B2C) in einem schnell wachsenden Unternehmen

 Praxis mit OKRs und Roadmapping: Du hast OKR-Zyklen produktübergreifend koordiniert und Roadmaps für mehrere Teams gepflegt und kommuniziert

 Sicherer Umgang mit Produktkennzahlen: Du hast Metriken definiert, Feature-Impact gemessen und Reporting für interne Stakeholder aufgebaut

 Du überzeugst über Argumente und Zahlen, nicht über deine Position, und diskutierst auch mit erfahrenen Product Managern auf Augenhöhe

 Die Bereitschaft, auch die Strukturarbeit selbst zu machen: Roadmaps pflegen, Updates einfordern, Reporting am Laufen halten

 Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (mindestens C1), weil du täglich in beiden Sprachen mit Product, Engineering und Leadership arbeitest

 Du kannst die Tätigkeit dauerhaft aus Deutschland ausüben und verfügst zum Start über die hierfür erforderliche Arbeitserlaubnis

 
 Das fällt positiv auf 
 Erfahrung als Head of Product. Voraussetzung ist sie nicht

 Mehrjährige eigene Produktverantwortung als Product Manager, bevor du in eine Leadership-Rolle gewechselt bist

 Erfahrung aus einer größeren Produktorganisation mit ausgereiften Arbeitsweisen

 Erfahrung mit Roadmap- und Produktmanagement-Tools wie airfocus, Productboard, Jira Product Discovery oder Aha!

 Erfahrung mit Produktanalyse-Tools wie PostHog, Amplitude oder Mixpanel

 Produkterfahrung in E-Commerce, Marktplätzen oder Digital Health

jobs.title: Scientific Product Manager (m/fd)
jobs.description:
Your mission Who we are 
 
 
 NeuroNation is the personalised training app that empowers more than 20 million people all over the world in staying brain healthy and happy in their lives. 
 We collaborate closely with scientists and universities to achieve the best results possible. Our engaging apps have received awards from major health insurance companies, such as the AOK, funded by the German Federal Ministry of Health. Also, we've been awarded by Apple and Google as one of the best apps available. 
 
 
 To improve the training experience our app provides and make the product more effective and engaging to users and patients, we are looking for a passionate person with a background in science and deep interest in digital health and games. Since the role touches many different fields, you don’t have to bring all know-how already with you - we are welcoming passionate learners who want to develop themselves in this role. 
 
 
 So, if you want to help us shape a better tomorrow, join us on our journey! 
 
 
 Your roles and responsibilities

jobs.title: Technical Product Owner | Integrations (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Superchat, we're rebuilding how businesses talk to their customers. AI is becoming the engine of that communication. Integrations are what give that engine teeth: the data, the tools, the systems that turn a clever agent into one that actually closes loops. 

 Founded in 2020, Superchat has become the platform of choice for 10,000+ businesses worldwide , from globally recognized brands like Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone, and GASAG to the small businesses, dental practices, and one-person startups that need to look bigger than they are. Today, millions of messages flow through Superchat every single day .

 We started as a unified inbox: one place for every channel a customer might pick, WhatsApp, email, SMS, Instagram. Then ChatGPT happened, and the second chapter began: AI agents that respond across chat, email, and voice at the quality of the best human teams.

 We're 100 people , profitable , and have raised €18M in funding (last round 4.5 years ago, we've been growing on our own money since). Headquartered in Berlin.

 We're looking for a Product Manager to join our Integrations team.

 In this role, you'll own the surface that decides whether our AI agents are clever demos or systems that actually do work. CRM sync, appointment bookings, call transfers, custom workflows: every action our agents take in the real world runs through your team. Plus our public API, webhooks, and the developer experience that lets partners build on top of us. If you're excited to design APIs, ship agent tooling, and own a surface that gets more strategic every quarter, this might be a great fit.

 We're reshaping our product function around three pillars, AI, Integrations, and Core, with a PM in each, operating directly with our founder and CPO Mika. This role is for Integrations.

 This role is technical, but you won't be writing the code

 You'll design API surfaces, debate OAuth and webhook patterns, and hold your own with senior engineers and external partner teams. The engineers write the code. Your job is to read it when needed, sketch API designs, argue technical trade-offs, and make sure what we ship is well architected. An engineering background, or serious hands-on coding experience, is what gets you that credibility.

 Location & work mode

 Berlin-based, minimum 3 days a week in-office, up to 2 days optional home office. We build better in the same room. Decisions happen faster, products ship faster, and the team stays sharper. EU work permit required.

 What you'll do

 
 Own integrations, the public API, and webhooks end-to-end: strategy, spec, build, launch, measure

 Build the tools that turn our AI agents from clever responders into systems that close loops: agent to CRM, agent to appointment, agent to handover, agent to custom workflow

 Stay close to customers and partners every week, in direct calls, by talking to CS, sales, and BD, and by digging into the data yourself

 Embed with 4 to 6 engineers, set the metric, and own whether it moves

 Treat the public API and webhooks as a product, with proper DX, docs, and a real roadmap

 Make integration setup something a customer completes in minutes, alone, without a CSM walking them through it

 Own quality. Engineers test as they build, you give the final go before anything ships

 Own the launch and the awareness that follows. There is no product marketing team. You drive positioning, the in-product moments, and the keynote for the big launches, with marketing and sales behind you

 Work across squads with the AI and Core PMs on the surfaces that touch each other

 
 What we're looking for

 
 5+ years experience in Product Management in B2B SaaS

 Background in Software Engineering

 A track record of shipping things people actually use

 Engineering background or strong hands-on coding experience

 Exceptional product and operational judgement

 Fluent in OAuth, webhooks, rate limits, retries, and API versioning. Tool-calling and function-calling patterns a strong plus

 Shameless customer obsession

 Extreme clarity in writing and thinking

 Speed without sloppiness

 Low ego and a builder's instinct

 
 What we offer

 
 Competitive salary and meaningful VSOP at a profitable, growing company

 Modern Berlin office in Prenzlauer Berg

 Direct work with the founders and a real seat at the product table

 A team that ships fast and doesn't drown in process

 26 days of paid vacation, plus 2 extra days off for Christmas and New Year's Eve

 Annual personal development budget for conferences, courses, books, or coaching

 Regular team events, off-sites, and the kind of culture that makes you want to be in the office

 
 See how we ship

 Every year we publish a Rewind: a public record of everything we built and shipped. Probably the easiest way to see what we've been up to.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager B2B (d/w/m*)
jobs.description:
Warum wir? Bei  pixx.io bist du Teil eines ambitionierten und unterstützenden Teams, das ein gemeinsames Ziel verfolgt: Unseren über 1.600 Kunden eine erstklassige SaaS-Lösung für Digital Asset Management (DAM) zu bieten und gleichzeitig neue Unternehmen von unserer Software zu begeistern. Gemeinsam machen wir digitales Arbeiten smarter und erfolgreicher – und du kannst einen wichtigen Beitrag dazu leisten.

 Freue dich auf: 
 spannende Herausforderungen: Arbeite an innovativen Projekten in einem dynamischen Umfeld und bringe deine Ideen ein, um unser SaaS-Produkt weiterzuentwickeln,
 moderne und nachhaltige Büros in Mühldorf ( https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mVc3LBJ8C9Q ) und in München ( https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=9hoq8-16O48 ), wobei du frei auswählen kannst, ob du remote innerhalb Deutschlands oder an einem unseren Standorte (gerne auch hybrid) arbeitest,
 unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit (40 Std.),
 30 Urlaubstage + jeweils einen freien Tag am 24.12. und 31.12.,
 marktgerechtes Gehalt (je nach Skill- und Erfahrungslevel),
 effizientes Onboarding (egal ob vor Ort oder remote),
 offene Fehler- und Feedbackkultur,
 tolle Weiterbildungs- und Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten,
 modernste Ausstattung, ergonomische Arbeitsplätze im Büro, Mitarbeitende werben Mitarbeitende-Programm, Zusammenhalt fördernde Team-Events und spaßige Firmenfeiern, faire Regelungen zu Workations innerhalb der EU, vergünstigte Wellpass Mitgliedschaft, Corporate Benefits & Co.
 

 Deine Aufgaben Durch ein stetig wachsendes DAM-Produkt, eine anspruchsvolle Zielgruppe aus Marketingverantwortlichen, steigende Anforderungen an unsere IT- und Entwicklungslandschaft sowie ambitionierte Unternehmensziele bauen wir unsere Produktorganisation weiter aus. Als  Senior Product Manager B2B (d/w/m*)  arbeitest du in unseren neu formierten, agilen, crossfunktionalen Domain-Teams und verantwortest eigenständig deine Produktfeatures: von der Identifikation relevanter Kundenprobleme über die Umsetzung bis hin zur Wirkung am Markt und mit Direct Report zum CEO.

 Im Detail bedeutet dies: 
 Produkt- & Domain-Verantwortung: Du verantwortest Strategie, Prioritäten und Outcomes für deinen Bereich und steuerst Kennzahlen wie Nutzung, Engagement, Retention, Kundenzufriedenheit und Umsatz.
 Discovery & Validierung: Durch regelmäßigen Kundenkontakt, Research und die Analyse von Nutzungsdaten entwickelst du ein tiefes Verständnis für reale Herausforderungen, identifizierst Wachstumspotenziale und leitest daraus die richtigen Produktentscheidungen ab.
 Delivery & Wirkung: Gemeinsam mit Design und Engineering übersetzt du validierte Probleme in wirksame Lösungen, priorisierst entlang klarer Ziele und misst kontinuierlich den Erfolg deiner Initiativen. Was keinen Mehrwert schafft, wird konsequent hinterfragt oder gestoppt.
 Stakeholder Management & Adoption: Du schaffst Alignment über Teams hinweg, vertrittst Prioritäten und Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar, forderst Verbindlichkeit ein und begleitest Rollouts sowie die erfolgreiche Nutzung neuer Funktionen.

 Was diese Rolle besonders macht: 
 Klare End-to-End-Verantwortung statt Feature-Abarbeitung,
 starke Kundennähe als zentraler Erfolgsfaktor,
 hoher Gestaltungsspielraum und echte Entscheidungskompetenz,
 Fokus auf Wirkung, nicht auf Output.
 

 Dein Profil Unser Team ist der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg. Deshalb suchen wir eine erfahrene Person im Produktmanagement, die Kundennähe mit Klarheit, Entscheidungsstärke und einem hohen Maß an Verantwortungsbewusstsein verbindet. Du verstehst es, unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammenzubringen, konstruktiv zu challengen und Veränderungen gemeinsam mit anderen erfolgreich voranzutreiben.

 Idealerweise bringst du zudem folgende Qualifikationen mit: 
 mind. 7 Jahre Berufserfahrung im B2B-Produktmanagement, davon mind. 3 Jahre im SaaS- oder MarTech-Umfeld in einem Start- oder ScaleUp,
 nachweisbare Erfolge bei Adoption, Engagement, Retention oder Expansion digitaler Produkte,
 ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten sowie Erfahrung im Umgang mit Produkt-KPIs, Experimenten und datenbasierten Entscheidungen,
 tiefe Kundennähe und die Fähigkeit, Nutzerbedürfnisse in wirksame Produktstrategien und Prioritäten zu übersetzen,
 ein hohes Maß an Ownership, Entscheidungsstärke und Ergebnisorientierung,
 Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit crossfunktionalen Teams,
 Kommunikationsstärke und Souveränität im Stakeholder-Management: Klarheit schaffen, Prioritäten überzeugend vertreten, Annahmen konstruktiv hinterfragen und auch begründet „Nein“ sagen können,
 die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Perspektiven zusammenzubringen, Verbindlichkeit zu schaffen und Veränderungen sowohl mit Fingerspitzengefühl sowie manchmal auch mit einer gesunden Portion Beharrlichkeit gemeinsam mit anderen erfolgreich voranzutreiben,
 Erfahrung im Einsatz von KI-Tools, z. B. für Prototyping,
 sehr gute Deutsch- (C2) und Englischkenntnisse (mind. B2),
 nice to have: Erfahrung in UX, Service Design oder User

jobs.title: Tech Lead, Android Core Product - Zurich, Switzerland
jobs.description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

With the growth of our Android app, being the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, we find the need for a Senior Android Engineer to help us support the new user base as well as work on new and exciting projects to push us forward.   

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount. 

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week. 

What You’ll Do

  • Owning major features and working closely with our design team - take ownership of features inside the app and become responsible of delivering high quality features
  • Shape the future of our Android team
  • Own, maintain and improve reliability metrics for key features
  • Participate in discussions across different teams - Product, Design, Engineering
  • Review pull requests, and support other teammates
  • Handle critical issues or cope with unexpected challenges 
  • Take ownership of feature releases and provide nightly builds for the QA team

An Ideal Candidate Should Have

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience
  • Familiarity with Android components
  • Experience building or contributing to at least one Android app
  • Product design intuition and user empathy
  • Drive to push the boundaries of Android UI/UX
  • Understanding of the importance of tests and how to approach writing tests
  • Self-drive to improve the app and codebase above and beyond what's outlined in the spec
  • Rock solid experience with Kotlin, Kotlin Coroutines, Kotlin Flow, Dagger 2, MVVM, Clean Architecture, Background Services, Music Player Service, Android Animations, Jetpack Navigation, JUnit tests
  • Excellent communication skills
  • User oriented problem solving approach
  • Driven with continuous feedback from leaders

Bonus:

  • Experience building, maintaining, or otherwise contributing to open source projects in Android
  • Experience with iOS, Web or NodeJS

Technologies we use:

  • Kotlin
  • Kotlin Coroutines
  • Kotlin Flow
  • Jetpack Navigation
  • Dagger 2
  • Room
  • Custom Views, Canvas & Paint
  • Jetpack Compose
  • JUnit

What We offer:

  • A fast-growing environment where you can help shape the company and product.
  • An entrepreneurial-minded team that supports risk, intuition, an
